items.title: 市場不信Fed會再升息？美債曲線出現罕見警訊
items.title_en: Market Doubts Fed Will Raise Rates Again? Rare Warning on US Treasury Curve
paras: 美國公債殖利率曲線在聯準會 (Fed) 本周決議維持利率不變後急遽陡峭化，短天期殖利率下降、長天期殖利率反而大幅走高，反映市場愈來愈懷疑 Fed 是否還會升息，也引發外界對央行抗通膨決心與政策公信力的擔憂。
Fed 主席華許本周三雖強調，若物價壓力未能緩解，決策官員將毫不猶豫採取行動，但市場反應顯示，投資人並不相信 Fed 即將啟動積極升息周期。
Fed 本周維持利率不變，儘管有 3 名官員投下反對票、主張升息。決議公布後，各天期美債殖利率最初全面下滑，反映投資人對央行未立即升息感到安心。然而，市場走勢很快出現明顯分歧，短天期殖利率持續下降，長天期公債殖利率卻急遽攀升，其中 30 年期殖利率更升至 19 年新高。

「扭轉式陡峭化」反映信心動搖

CreditSights 總體經濟與投資級債券策略主管葛里菲斯 (Zachary Griffiths) 將這種走勢形容為「扭轉式陡峭化」(twist steepener)，並稱其為市場對 Fed 決策的「不健康反應」。
殖利率曲線陡峭化走勢周四持續，2 年期與 10 年期、2 年期與 30 年期美債殖利率差距均進一步擴大。Truist Wealth 固定收益部門董事總經理休伊 (Chip Hughey) 表示，殖利率曲線的扭轉顯示，市場認為 Fed 不會展開激進升息周期。這或許有利經濟成長，卻會為 Fed 對抗通膨的行動增添更多不確定性。
分析師認為，Fed 選擇按兵不動的原因之一，是即使央行沒有進一步升息，金融情勢也已明顯收緊。華許指出，市場實際上已替 Fed 完成許多工作，投資人根據最新經濟數據調整部位，推動名目與經通膨調整後的美債殖利率同步升高，而非完全依賴 Fed 提供的政策指引。
10 年期美債殖利率 7 月以來已上升 25 個基點，創 3 月以來最大單月升幅。不過，這次曲線陡峭化並非典型的「熊市陡峭化」。一般情況下，各天期殖利率會同步上升，只是長端升幅更大；此次卻是短端下滑、長端攀升，凸顯市場對近期利率與長期通膨風險的看法正朝相反方向發展。

非農就業成 Fed 公信力考驗

殖利率曲線變陡通常代表市場正在反映未來降息，或至少不會再升息。這次走勢也顯示，投資人正在解除先前押注 Fed 將於 7 月升息，或因中東緊張情勢升高而暗示即將進一步緊縮的部位。
Fed 會議前，市場一度完全反映 9 月前升息約 25 個基點的預期，2 年期與 10 年期殖利率差則在會議前一周縮小 5 個基點。法國巴黎銀行美國利率策略主管丁格拉 (Guneet Dhingra) 表示，曲線重新陡峭化意味 Fed 在 6 月會議後建立的抗通膨公信力，已有相當大一部分流失。若央行未清楚表明升息仍是政策選項，公信力恐進一步遭到侵蝕。
Azimut Group 全球固定收益共同主管博欽 (Nicolò Bocchin) 指出，Fed 改採減少前瞻指引的新做法，讓市場感到迷失。投資人因而更加擔心通膨，並將相關風險反映在長天期公債價格上。
下周公布的 7 月非農就業報告將成為這項市場觀點的重要考驗。葛里菲斯表示，若就業數據優於預期，可能強化市場對 Fed 本周本應升息的質疑，使殖利率曲線進一步陡峭化；若數據疲弱，則可能緩解 Fed 落後通膨情勢的擔憂，促使目前走勢迅速逆轉。
paras_en: The US Treasury yield curve steepened sharply after the Federal Reserve (Fed) decided to keep rates unchanged this week, with short‑term yields falling and long‑term yields jumping, reflecting growing market skepticism that the Fed will raise rates further and raising concerns about the central bank’s anti‑inflation resolve and policy credibility.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell emphasized on Wednesday that if price pressures do not ease, policymakers will act without hesitation, but market reaction showed investors do not believe the Fed is about to start an aggressive rate‑hiking cycle.

The Fed left rates unchanged this week despite three officials voting against and urging a hike. After the decision was announced, yields across all maturities initially fell, indicating investors were reassured the central bank would not hike immediately. However, the market quickly split, with short‑term yields continuing to drop while long‑term Treasury yields surged, the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level in 19 years.
The “twist steepener” reflects waning confidence
CreditSights senior economist and investment‑grade bond strategist Zachary Griffiths described the move as a “twist steepener” and called it an “unhealthy reaction” to Fed policy decisions.

The steepening of the yield curve continued on Thursday, with the spread between 2‑year and 10‑year, and between 2‑year and 30‑year Treasuries widening further. Truist Wealth fixed‑income managing director Chip Hughey said the curve twist shows the market believes the Fed will not embark on a aggressive hiking cycle. That may be supportive of growth but adds uncertainty to the Fed’s fight against inflation.

Analysts say one reason the Fed chose to stand pat is that even without further hikes, financial conditions have already tightened noticeably. Powell noted that the market has effectively done much of the Fed’s work, with investors adjusting positions based on the latest data, pushing both nominal and inflation‑adjusted Treasury yields higher rather than relying solely on Fed guidance.

The 10‑year Treasury yield has risen 25 basis points since July, the biggest monthly gain since March. However, this steepening is not a typical “bear‑steepening.” Normally, yields across maturities rise together, with the long end moving more; this time the short end fell while the long end rose, highlighting a shift in market views on near‑term rates versus long‑term inflation risk.

Yield‑curve steepening usually signals the market is pricing in future rate cuts or at least no more hikes. This move also shows investors are shedding bets that the Fed would hike in July or that Middle‑East tensions would prompt further tightening.

Ahead of the Fed meeting, the market had fully priced in about a 25‑basis‑point hike before September, and the 2‑year/10‑year spread had narrowed by five basis points in the week before the meeting. BNP Paribas US rates strategist Guneet Dhingra said the renewed steepening means a sizable portion of the credibility the Fed built after the June meeting has already eroded. If the central bank does not clearly signal that hikes remain an option, credibility could be further damaged.

Azimut Group global fixed‑income co‑head Nicolò Bocchin noted that the Fed’s shift to less forward guidance has left the market disoriented. Investors are therefore more worried about inflation and are reflecting that risk in long‑term Treasury prices.

The July non‑farm payrolls report due next week will be a key test of this market view. Griffiths said that if employment data come in stronger than expected, it could reinforce doubts that the Fed should have raised rates this week and push the yield curve even steeper; weaker data could ease concerns that the Fed is lagging behind inflation and trigger a rapid reversal of the current trend.

items.title: 南韓券商KIS：三星電子遭嚴重低估 目標價上調10%至65萬韓元
items.title_en: South Korean Brokerage KIS: Samsung Electronics Severely Undervalued, Target Price Raised 10% to 650,000 KRW
paras: 三星電子發布了超預期的第二季度財報，強勁的獲利表現引發市場高度關注。南韓投資證券 (KIS) 隨即發布研報，將三星電子目標價上調 10% 至 65 萬韓元，並強調該公司正經歷從傳統「週期驅動」向「訂單驅動」的商業模式轉型，目前其估值處於嚴重低估狀態。
財報數據顯示，三星電子第二季度營收達 171.5 兆韓元，同比增長 130%；營業利潤飆升至 89.5 兆韓元，同比暴增 1814%，較市場預期高出約 5.5%。值得注意的是，公司利潤幾乎全部由半導體業務貢獻，該部門營業利潤達 89.2 兆韓元，佔整體利潤的 99.7%。
獲利大幅增長的主因在於記憶體價格回升，其中 DRAM 平均售價環比上漲逾 40%，NAND 則漲逾 60%。
KIS 指出，三星與全球五大超大規模數據中心客戶簽署的五年長期供貨協議，正根本性地改變記憶體產業長期以來的供需博弈模式。過去廠商主要依據市場預測規劃產能，容易陷入供給過剩的週期波動；而在新模式下，產能規劃將更多建立在客戶訂單之上。
根據規劃，未來長期合約預計將覆蓋 60% 至 70% 的 DRAM 與 NAND 產能，其餘部分則保留在現貨市場銷售，以兼顧供應穩定性與價格上漲的收益彈性。
在當前熱門的 HBM(高頻寬記憶體) 領域，三星採取了相對均衡的策略。公司並未盲目追求產能擴張，而是根據客戶需求動態調整 HBM 與傳統 DRAM 的生產比例，更看重長期的供應穩定性與客戶合作。
儘管基本面顯著改善，但三星電子目前的市淨率 (PBR) 僅約 1.3 倍，處於歷史低位。加上公司重申將以年度經營性自由現金流 (FCF) 的 50% 作為股東回報基礎，明確的派息政策為估值提供了強力支撐。KIS 認為，隨著獲利穩定性與可預測性的提升，三星電子的中長期投資價值已日益凸顯。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics released an unexpectedly strong Q2 earnings report, with robust profit performance drawing intense market attention. South Korean investment securities firm KIS promptly issued a research note, raising Samsung Electronics' target price by 10% to 650,000 KRW, and emphasizing that the company is undergoing a shift from a traditional "cycle‑driven" to an "order‑driven" business model, with its valuation now severely undervalued.

The earnings data show Samsung Electronics' Q2 revenue reached 171.5 trillion KRW, up 130% year‑on‑year; operating profit surged to 89.5 trillion KRW, a 1,814% year‑on‑year increase and about 5.5% above market expectations. Notably, almost all of the profit came from the semiconductor business, whose operating profit was 89.2 trillion KRW, accounting for 99.7% of total profit.
The profit jump was mainly driven by a rebound in memory prices, with average DRAM selling prices rising more than 40% month‑on‑month and NAND prices climbing over 60%.

KIS points out that Samsung's five‑year long‑term supply agreements with the world’s five largest hyperscale data‑center customers are fundamentally changing the long‑standing supply‑demand dynamics in the memory industry. Previously, manufacturers planned capacity based on market forecasts, often leading to oversupply cycles; under the new model, capacity planning will be more anchored to customer orders.

According to the plan, future long‑term contracts are expected to cover 60% to 70% of DRAM and NAND capacity, with the remainder sold on the spot market to balance supply stability and price‑rise upside potential.

In the currently hot HBM (high‑bandwidth memory) segment, Samsung has taken a relatively balanced approach. The company does not blindly pursue capacity expansion but dynamically adjusts the production mix of HBM and traditional DRAM based on customer demand, placing greater emphasis on long‑term supply stability and customer collaboration.

Despite the marked improvement in fundamentals, Samsung Electronics' price‑to‑book ratio (PBR) is only about 1.3×, near historic lows. Coupled with the company's reaffirmation that it will use 50% of annual operating free cash flow (FCF) as the basis for shareholder returns, its clear dividend policy provides strong valuation support. KIS believes that as profit stability and predictability improve, Samsung Electronics' medium‑ to long‑term investment value is becoming increasingly evident.

items.title: 華爾街開始挑AI贏家！亞馬遜開盤狂飆逾13%、蘋果慘跌近9%
items.title_en: Wall Street Starts Picking AI Winners! Amazon Soars Over 13% at Open, Apple Plummets Nearly 9%
paras: 亞馬遜與蘋果周五 (31 日) 開盤股價走勢呈現巨大反差，亞馬遜暴漲逾 13%，蘋果則重挫近 9%，顯示投資人正根據企業財報與人工智慧 (AI) 策略，挑選新一輪科技股贏家。
截稿前，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 周五盤中股價上漲 13.52%，每股暫報 267.34 美元；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 盤中股價下跌 8.63%，每股暫報 304.64 美元。
兩家公司均於周四盤後公布第二季財報。蘋果獲利、營收及 iPhone 銷售額全數優於市場預期，但本季財測疲弱，成為股價遭到拋售的主因。
蘋果預估，本季營收將成長 9% 至 11%，低於 LSEG 調查分析師預期的 12%。公司表示，供應限制正在影響成長，除了關鍵零組件記憶體嚴重短缺外，先進晶片製造產能競爭也日益激烈。
供應吃緊已促使蘋果調高 Mac 與 iPad 售價，分析師預期 iPhone 也可能於今年漲價。儘管市場需求依然強勁，投資人仍擔心成本升高及供貨不足，將限制蘋果短期營收成長。
相較之下，亞馬遜第二季雲端運算業務營收年增 37%，創 2021 年以來最快增速。亞馬遜網路服務 (AWS) 是公司大部分 AI 相關營收的主要來源，其強勁表現反映企業對 AI 產品及運算資源的需求持續升溫。
亞馬遜同時將今年資本支出預估由 2,000 億美元調高至 2,200 億美元，持續擴建 AI 基礎設施。市場近期愈來愈擔心大型科技公司投資速度超越實際需求，但 AWS 的高速成長，讓投資人相信亞馬遜的龐大支出能夠帶來回報。
Forrester 首席分析師 Tracy Woo 表示，AWS 的強勁成長清楚顯示，亞馬遜的基礎設施投資正在滿足市場需求，而非過度超前部署。
亞馬遜今年以來股價表現相對落後，即使計入周五漲幅，累計僅上漲約 4%；蘋果同期則上漲 23%。蘋果先前因未大舉擴張 AI 資本支出，被視為重金投資 AI 科技巨頭的替代選擇，但這項優勢如今受到供應瓶頸考驗。
大型科技股走勢正隨 AI 策略明顯分歧。Meta(META-US)周四重挫 8%，微軟 (MSFT-US) 卻大漲 15%，加上亞馬遜與蘋果周五走勢分歧，顯示投資人不再全面追捧科技股，而是更重視 AI 支出能否轉化為實際營收與獲利。
paras_en: Amazon and Apple showed a stark contrast in opening price movements on Friday (the 31st), with Amazon surging more than 13% while Apple slumped nearly 9%, indicating that investors are selecting the next round of tech winners based on corporate earnings and artificial intelligence (AI) strategies.
Before the deadline, Amazon (AMZN-US) was up 13.52% during Friday’s session, briefly trading at $267.34 per share; Apple (AAPL-US) was down 8.63%, briefly at $304.64 per share.

Both companies released their Q2 earnings after Thursday’s market close. Apple’s profit, revenue and iPhone sales all beat market expectations, but a weak outlook for the current quarter became the main driver of the stock’s sell‑off.

Apple forecasts current‑quarter revenue growth of 9% to 11%, below the 12% expected by LSEG analysts. The company said supply constraints are curbing growth, with severe shortages of key memory components and increasingly fierce competition for advanced chip‑making capacity.

Tight supply has already forced Apple to raise prices for Macs and iPads, and analysts expect iPhone prices could also rise this year. Although market demand remains strong, investors worry that higher costs and insufficient supply will limit Apple’s short‑term revenue growth.

In contrast, Amazon’s Q2 cloud computing revenue grew 37% year‑over‑year, the fastest pace since 2021. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the main source of the company’s AI‑related revenue, and its strong performance reflects sustained corporate demand for AI products and compute resources.

Amazon also raised its capital‑expenditure outlook for the year from $200 billion to $220 billion, continuing to expand AI infrastructure. While markets have grown increasingly concerned that big‑tech spending may outpace actual demand, AWS’s rapid growth reassures investors that Amazon’s massive outlays can deliver returns.
Forrester chief analyst Tracy Woo said AWS’s robust growth clearly shows that Amazon’s infrastructure investments are meeting market demand rather than being over‑built.

Amazon’s stock has lagged this year; even with Friday’s jump, it’s up only about 4% year‑to‑date, whereas Apple is up 23% over the same period. Apple was previously seen as an alternative to heavy‑spending AI giants because it had not aggressively expanded AI capital spending, but that advantage is now being tested by supply bottlenecks.

Big‑tech stock moves are diverging sharply based on AI strategies. Meta (META-US) fell 8% on Thursday, while Microsoft (MSFT-US) surged 15%, and the opposite moves of Amazon and Apple on Friday show investors are no longer uniformly chasing tech stocks but are focusing on whether AI spending can translate into real revenue and profit.

items.title: 微軟AI戰略轉向 終於讓投資人不再因OpenAI而看衰股價
items.title_en: Microsoft Shifts AI Strategy, Relieving Investor Concerns Over OpenAI-Driven Stock Decline
paras: 科技巨頭微軟 (MSFT-US) 在最新的第四財季業績電話會議中，為人工智慧 (AI) 領域的投資者傳遞了一個至關重要的信號：企業級 AI 的未來可能不再僅僅取決於某個「單一基礎模型」，而是屬於那些提供強大技術支援的「基礎設施提供商」。
微軟執行長納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 在業績會議上多次強調，微軟目前的戰略核心是「賦予客戶訪問多種 AI 模型的權利」，代表微軟不再綁死 OpenAI。
雖然微軟與 OpenAI 的合作關係仍受矚目，但納德拉明確表示，微軟的生態系統不僅包含 OpenAI 的 GPT 系列，還廣泛納入包括 Anthropic、xAI、Mistral 以及微軟自家的 MAI 系列模型。
目前，微軟旗下的雲端服務平台 Azure 已能提供超過 11,000 個 AI 模型供客戶選擇。
數據顯示，企業端對於「多供應商模型」的需求正呈現爆炸式增長，利用來自多個提供商的模型來構建應用程式的客戶數量，在近期增長了五倍之多。這種「平台化」與「多樣化」的趨勢，顯示出企業在部署 AI 時，更傾向於選擇能提供多元整合與穩定基礎設施的合作夥伴，而非將所有籌碼押在單一模型上。
對於 ETF 投資者而言，這一趨勢意味著市場重心正在發生位移。過去，市場主要關注誰能開發出「最強模型」；然而，隨著模型競爭進入白熱化，能夠支持這些模型運行、運算與整合的「基礎設施」反而成為更穩定的投資目標。
這一轉向顯示，微軟的轉型對 AI 基礎設施 ETF 的利好，可能已經超過了直接投資或押注 OpenAI。當企業不再只依賴單一模型，而是需要一個強大的環境來測試、訓練與執行不同的 AI 應用時，微軟、輝達 (NVDA-US) 等提供雲端算力與平台服務的企業，其護城河將變得更加穩固。
在業績公佈後，相關科技股表現分化。微軟股價表現強勁，漲幅達 15.51%，顯示市場對其 AI 基礎設施戰略的認可。與此同時，作為基礎設施核心的晶片龍頭輝達也上漲了 2.65%，進一步印證了基礎設施商在 AI 浪潮中的受益地位。相較之下，其他科技巨頭如 Meta(META-US) 則出現了 7.95% 的跌幅，顯示市場正在重新評估各家公司在 AI 產業鏈中的定位。
paras_en: Tech giant Microsoft (MSFT-US) signaled a crucial message to AI investors during its latest Q4 earnings call: the future of enterprise AI may no longer hinge on a single foundational model, but on those that act as robust infrastructure providers.
CEO Satya Nadella repeatedly emphasized that Microsoft’s strategic core now is “empowering customers to access a variety of AI models,” indicating the company is no longer locked into OpenAI.

While Microsoft’s partnership with OpenAI remains in the spotlight, Nadella made clear that Microsoft’s ecosystem includes not only OpenAI’s GPT series but also models from Anthropic, xAI, Mistral and Microsoft’s own MAI series.
Microsoft’s Azure cloud platform now offers customers access to more than 11,000 AI models.

Data shows enterprise demand for “multi‑vendor models” is exploding, with the number of customers building applications using models from multiple providers having surged five‑fold recently. This platform‑centric, diversified trend shows enterprises prefer partners that provide broad integration and stable infrastructure rather than betting on a single model.

For ETF investors, the trend signals a shift in market focus. Previously the market chased whoever could develop the “strongest model”; now, as model competition intensifies, the “infrastructure” that supports, computes and integrates those models becomes a more stable investment target.

This pivot suggests Microsoft’s transformation benefits AI‑infrastructure ETFs more than direct bets on OpenAI. As enterprises move away from reliance on a single model and need a powerful environment to test, train and run diverse AI applications, companies like Microsoft and Nvidia (NVDA-US) that supply cloud compute and platform services see their moats solidify.

After the earnings release, tech stocks moved in divergent directions. Microsoft’s share price jumped 15.51%, reflecting market approval of its AI‑infrastructure strategy. At the same time, chip leader Nvidia, a core infrastructure player, rose 2.65%, further confirming the benefit to infrastructure providers in the AI wave. By contrast, other tech giants such as Meta (META-US) fell 7.95%, indicating the market is re‑evaluating each company’s position in the AI value chain.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉亞馬遜與晶片股領漲 主要指數開高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as Amazon and Chip Stocks Lead Gains
paras: 美股周五 (31 日) 開高，科技股延續前一日反彈氣勢，那斯達克指數連續第二個交易日走揚。亞馬遜公布強勁財報，雲端業務營收成長優於預期，緩解市場對人工智慧 (AI) 龐大投資回報的疑慮，激勵股價開盤大漲約 12%，抵銷蘋果因財測不如預期而重挫的壓力。
與此同時，資金持續回補 7 月遭大幅拋售的晶片股，帶動科技類股全面走強，華爾街在震盪劇烈的 7 月最後一個交易日展開強勁反攻。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 210 點或 0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 280 點或 1.1%，標普 500 指數漲 0.6%，費城半導體指數漲近 4.2%。台積電 ADR 漲近 2.5%。
科技股周五全面反彈，晶片股延續升勢，亞馬遜股價更大漲 10%，帶動市場以相對樂觀的氣氛結束 7 月交易。先前最受追捧的人工智慧 (AI) 交易在本月遭遇劇烈估值修正，但企業財報展現強勁獲利能力，緩解投資人對 AI 投資回報的疑慮。
南韓股市率先點燃全球科技股反攻行情，南韓綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 史無前例暴漲 18%，記憶體晶片大廠 SK 海力士觸及 30% 漲停限制。那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.9%，標普 500 指數期貨漲 0.2%，追蹤晶片類股的 ETF 在美股早盤上漲 3.3%。歐洲 Stoxx 600 指數則觸及歷史新高。
不過，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 因營收展望不如預期，股價重挫 7.6%，成為科技股反彈中的少數例外。

AI 交易洗牌告一段落

本周稍晚的反彈，讓經歷 7 月晶片股大幅下殺的投資人暫時鬆一口氣。市場人士認為，AI 避險基金 Situational Awareness 被迫出售投資部位，是先前相關股票持續承壓的原因之一。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 本周稍早公布強勁財報後，市場逐漸回穩。亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 隨後公布，旗下雲端運算部門創下 2021 年以來最快單季成長速度，讓投資人相信，公司預計 2026 年投入 2,200 億美元資本支出，將能產生回報並支撐全球 AI 基礎設施建設。
Lombard Odier Investment Managers 策略師耶爾波 (Florian Ielpo) 表示，最嚴重的部位清洗可能已經結束，科技股估值較一個月前合理，但仍稱不上便宜。他認為，這並不代表 AI 交易走到盡頭，而是最容易賺錢的階段可能已經結束。
《彭博》策略師博伊德 (Sebastian Boyd) 指出，這是多年來美國企業表現最亮眼的財報季，尤其科技公司在 AI 熱潮帶動下，獲利普遍大幅超越預期，顯示近期晶片股跌勢可能已經過頭。

Fed、油價與日元牽動 8 月行情

中東局勢持續緊張，布蘭特原油上漲 1.4%，突破每桶 90 美元。伊朗國營媒體 IRIB News 報導，6 艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽遭到阻擋；裏海石油管線聯盟也預計於周五稍晚決定，是否因水道安全疑慮而無限期停止營運。
美債短天期殖利率走高，30 年期殖利率則大致持平於 5.21%。美國第二季就業成本增幅略高於市場預期，美元上漲 0.4%。Fed 本周在通膨仍高於目標之際維持利率不變後，長天期美債殖利率升至多年高點，貨幣政策後續走向持續受到市場關注。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 與明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 均警告，若 Fed 遲遲不採取行動，未來可能被迫祭出更激烈的緊縮政策。兩人也是本周反對維持利率不變的 3 名官員之一。
日本銀行 (日本央行 / BOJ) 維持利率不變，總裁植田和男也未釋出更多支撐日元的訊號，日元因而在平盤上下震盪。《彭博》根據央行帳戶推算，日本周四可能斥資約 528 億美元干預匯市。
進入 8 月後，通膨、利率預期及 AI 成長故事能否延續，仍將主導市場方向。投資人將密切關注逼近 5.2% 的 30 年期美債殖利率，以及 8 月 12 日公布的 7 月通膨數據。耶爾波警告，8 月市場交易通常較清淡，普通經濟數據也可能引發超乎尋常的波動，市場緊張程度恐高於基本面所能解釋的範圍。

華爾街分析：

橋水基金創始人達里歐 (Ray Dalio) 認為，目前市場已經出現部分符合歷史泡沫規律的特徵。雖然 AI 具有改變生產方式的革命性價值，但投資者可能正在忽略技術價值與市場價格之間的差距。當資產估值遠高於其實際獲利能力時，市場一旦面臨資金環境收緊，泡沫風險可能迅速暴露。
針對投資策略，達里歐建議投資人避免將財富集中於單一資產，而應透過多元化配置降低風險。他認為，股票、現金、黃金、債券和房地產等資產在不同經濟周期的表現並不相同，合理組合能提高資產抵禦不確定性的能力。
paras_en: U.S. stocks opened higher on Friday (the 31st), with technology shares continuing the rebound momentum from the previous day, sending the Nasdaq index up for a second consecutive session. Amazon reported a strong earnings report, with cloud revenue growth beating expectations, easing market concerns about the massive investment returns from artificial intelligence (AI) and spurring the stock to jump about 12% at the open, offsetting pressure from Apple’s sharp drop after its earnings fell short of forecasts.

At the same time, investors kept adding to chip stocks that had been heavily sold off in July, lifting the broader tech sector and prompting a strong counter‑attack on Wall Street on the last, volatile trading day of July.

By the time of writing, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 210 points, or 0.4%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 280 points, or 1.1%, the S&P 500 gained 0.6%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed roughly 4.2%. TSMC ADR was up nearly 2.5%.

Technology stocks rebounded across the board on Friday, chip stocks kept climbing, and Amazon surged another 10%, helping the market close July on a relatively optimistic note. The AI‑related trades that had been the most chased earlier this month suffered a sharp valuation correction, but strong corporate earnings eased investors’ worries about AI investment returns.

South Korea’s market sparked the global tech rally, with the KOSPI soaring an unprecedented 18% and memory‑chip giant SK Hynix hitting the 30% daily limit. Nasdaq‑100 futures rose 0.9%, S&P 500 futures were up 0.2%, and an ETF tracking chip stocks gained 3.3% in early U.S. trading. Europe’s Stoxx 600 hit a record high.
However, Apple (AAPL-US) fell 7.6% after its revenue outlook missed expectations, becoming one of the few exceptions in the tech rebound.
AI‑trade reshuffling winds down

The later‑week rebound gave investors who saw chip stocks plunge in July a brief sigh of relief. Market participants said that the forced liquidation of the AI‑hedge fund Situational Awareness was one reason related stocks had stayed under pressure.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) steadied the market after posting a strong earnings report earlier in the week. Amazon (AMZN-US) then disclosed that its cloud division posted the fastest quarterly growth since 2021, convincing investors that the company’s planned $220 billion of capital expenditures by 2026 would generate returns and support global AI infrastructure building.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers strategist Florian Ielpo said the most severe position clean‑up may be over, and tech valuations are now more reasonable than a month ago, though still not cheap. He added that this does not signal the end of AI trading, but rather that the easiest profit‑making phase may have passed.

Bloomberg strategist Sebastian Boyd noted this has been the brightest earnings season for U.S. companies in years, especially tech firms whose AI‑driven profits largely beat expectations, suggesting the recent chip‑stock decline may have been overdone.
Fed, oil and yen shape August outlook

Middle‑East tensions kept Brent crude up 1.4%, breaking $90 a barrel. Iran’s state media IRIB News reported six tankers blocked in the Hormuz Strait; the Caspian oil‑pipeline alliance is expected to decide later Friday whether to suspend operations indefinitely over waterway‑security concerns.

U.S. short‑term Treasury yields rose while the 30‑year rate held around 5.21%. U.S. Q2 employment‑cost growth was slightly above expectations, pushing the dollar up 0.4%. After the Fed left rates unchanged despite inflation staying above target, long‑term Treasury yields climbed to multi‑year highs, keeping monetary‑policy direction in focus.

Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari warned that if the Fed delays action, it may have to resort to more aggressive tightening later. Both were among three officials this week who opposed keeping rates steady.

The Bank of Japan left rates unchanged and Governor Kazuo Ueda offered no further yen‑support signals, leaving the yen to wobble around flat. Bloomberg estimated the BOJ could spend about $52.8 billion on currency intervention on Thursday.

Going into August, whether inflation, rate expectations and the AI growth story can persist will continue to steer markets. Investors will watch the 30‑year Treasury yield, now near 5.2%, and July’s inflation data due on August 12. Ielpo cautioned that August trading is usually thin and that ordinary economic releases could trigger outsized volatility, with market anxiety potentially exceeding what fundamentals justify.

As of about 21:00 Taipei time on Friday (the 31st): Dow Jones Industrial Average up 216.35 points or 0.41% at 52,424.41; Nasdaq Composite up 235.22 points or 0.94% at 25,357.40; S&P 500 up 39.75 points or 0.53% at 7,477.38; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up 433.86 points or 3.84% at 11,736.85; TSMC ADR up 3.76% to $418.44; 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 4.7%; NY light crude up 2.39% to $85.59 a barrel; Brent crude up 1.48% to $90.35 a barrel; gold down 1.63% to $4,092.80 an ounce; dollar index up to 100.22.

Stock focus: Chevron (CVX-US) rose 1.49% in early trading to $195.17 a share. Chevron’s pre‑market move was modest; the energy giant posted Q2 results with profit and revenue both beating expectations, net income hitting $12.1 billion, nearly a 400% jump from a year earlier.
ExxonMobil (XOM-US) fell 1.48% in early trading to $154.65 a share. Exxon’s pre‑market price slipped 2%; its Q2 adjusted EPS was $3.52, below LSEG analysts’ $3.60 estimate.

Moderna (MRNA-US) rose 0.60% in early trading to $58.27 a share. Moderna’s pre‑market price fell more than 4% despite Q2 results beating Wall Street forecasts. The company posted a loss of $1.97 per share on revenue of $145 million, better than analysts’ loss estimate of $2.03 per share and revenue estimate of $102.9 million, and its full‑year revenue outlook was also above expectations.
Key economic data today: U.S. July final consumer confidence index expected at 54.4, prior 49.5.

Wall Street analysis: Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio said the market now shows some characteristics of historic bubbles. While AI has revolutionary potential to reshape production, investors may be overlooking the gap between technological value and market price. When asset valuations far exceed actual earnings power, a tightening funding environment could quickly expose bubble risks.

Regarding investment strategy, Dalio advises investors to avoid concentrating wealth in a single asset and to diversify across stocks, cash, gold, bonds and real estate, as each performs differently across economic cycles, and a balanced mix can improve resilience to uncertainty.

items.title: Kimi K3背後推手曝光！阿里巴巴提供2萬顆輝達晶片算力
items.title_en: Backer Behind Kimi K3 Revealed! Alibaba Supplies 20,000 Nvidia Chips for Compute Power
paras: 中國 AI 新創月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 與阿里巴巴集團 (BABA-US)(09988-HK) 簽署算力合作協議，可使用約 2 萬顆輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，其中相當大一部分算力用於開發 Kimi 系列模型，凸顯即使美國持續收緊出口管制，中國 AI 產業仍高度依賴西方先進半導體。
外媒周五 (31 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，這批硬體構成月之暗面整體算力的重要部分。月之暗面本月稍早推出開源 AI 模型 Kimi K3，部分性能指標已逼近 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等美國領先業者的模型，引發華府、華爾街與矽谷高度關注，市場擔心中國 AI 公司正迅速縮小與美國頂尖實驗室的差距。
月之暗面、阿里巴巴與輝達均拒絕評論相關合作。

阿里雲算力養出強勁對手

阿里巴巴是月之暗面最大投資人之一，並期望被投資公司使用旗下雲端服務。但雙方同時也是 AI 市場競爭對手，如今月之暗面利用阿里巴巴提供的基礎設施開發 Kimi，卻在多項重要性能指標上超越阿里巴巴自家的通義千問 (Qwen) 模型。
知情人士表示，兩支 AI 團隊取得的訓練資源相近，Kimi K3 表現領先因此令部分阿里巴巴內部人士感到失望。這也形成微妙局面：阿里巴巴一方面透過投資及雲端服務扶植中國 AI 新創，另一方面卻可能親手培養出威脅自身產品的競爭者。
Kimi K3 的突破令人聯想到 DeepSeek 去年帶來的震撼，也重新引發市場對西方 AI 基礎設施投資效益的討論。美國科技公司正投入數千億美元，興建裝滿高階 AI 加速器的資料中心；中國企業在取得先進晶片受限的情況下，卻依然開發出逼近美國頂尖模型的產品，讓投資人開始質疑龐大硬體支出是否必然能轉化為技術領先。

華府指控取得 Blackwell 晶片

白宮科技政策辦公室主任克拉齊奧斯 (Michael Kratsios) 上周指控，月之暗面非法取得輝達最先進的 Blackwell 晶片，但並未說明美國政府認為該公司擁有多少顆處理器。川普曾明確表示，不希望中國取得 Blackwell 系列 AI 加速器；美國官員也認為 DeepSeek 持有相關晶片。
不過，美國現行規則通常允許中國企業透過算力租賃協議使用相同晶片。克拉齊奧斯聲稱，月之暗面透過泰國某個未具名合作方取得 Blackwell 算力，並可能用於訓練 Kimi K3。他另指控月之暗面運用「蒸餾」技術，使用 Anthropic 旗下 Fable 模型產生的輸出訓練 K3，以彌補算力資源不足，但沒有提出具體證據。
熟悉月之暗面採購策略的人士證實，該公司確實有管道透過東南亞取得 Blackwell 處理器，但未說明是合法的算力租賃，或違反美國規定的直接購買。《The Information》本周則報導，月之暗面正尋求更多 Blackwell 晶片，準備訓練下一代模型。
至於阿里巴巴提供的約 2 萬顆晶片，知情人士稱其來自輝達上一代 Hopper 架構。多名接近月之暗面的人士指出，協議涉及 Hopper 系列中性能最強的 H200 晶片，但阿里巴巴發言人否認向月之暗面提供以 H200 驅動的算力，卻未否認雙方存在約 2 萬顆輝達晶片規模的算力合作，也拒絕透露實際晶片型號。
美國已核准部分 H200 直接銷往中國，但美國高層官員近期表示，實際出貨數量微不足道。北京也對批准國內企業購買 H200 態度保留，並施壓業者改用華為等中國本土晶片。中國雲端業者過去曾透過海外據點使用外國企業持有的受限晶片，再將算力轉租給中國客戶。阿里巴巴提供給月之暗面的算力究竟位於何處，目前仍不清楚。
paras_en: China AI startup Moonshot AI and Alibaba Group (BABA-US)(09988-HK) have signed a compute‑power cooperation agreement that allows the use of about 20,000 Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips, a large portion of which will be devoted to developing the Kimi series models. This highlights that, despite tightening U.S. export controls, China’s AI industry remains heavily dependent on advanced Western semiconductors.

Foreign media reported on Friday (the 31st) that insiders say this batch of hardware forms a key part of Moonshot AI’s overall compute capacity. Earlier this month Moonshot AI launched the open‑source AI model Kimi K3, whose performance metrics are already approaching those of leading U.S. firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic, drawing intense attention from Washington, Wall Street and Silicon Valley. The market worries that Chinese AI firms are rapidly closing the gap with top U.S. labs.
Moonshot AI, Alibaba and Nvidia all declined to comment on the collaboration.
Alibaba Cloud Fuels a Strong Competitor

Alibaba is one of Moonshot AI’s biggest investors and hopes the investee will use its cloud services. At the same time the two are rivals in the AI market. Now Moonshot AI is using Alibaba‑provided infrastructure to develop Kimi, yet on several important performance indicators it outperforms Alibaba’s own Tongyi Qwen model.

Insiders say the two AI teams have comparable training resources, and Kimi K3’s lead performance has disappointed some Alibaba staff. This creates a delicate situation: Alibaba supports Chinese AI startups through investment and cloud services, while potentially nurturing a competitor that threatens its own products.

Kimi K3’s breakthrough evokes the shock caused by DeepSeek last year and reignites debate over the return on Western AI infrastructure spending. U.S. tech firms are pouring hundreds of billions of dollars into data centers packed with high‑end AI accelerators; Chinese companies, despite limited access to advanced chips, are still building products that approach the top U.S. models, prompting investors to question whether massive hardware outlays necessarily translate into technological leadership.
Washington Accuses Acquisition of Blackwell Chips

White House technology policy chief Michael Kratsios last week accused Moonshot AI of illegally obtaining Nvidia’s most advanced Blackwell chips, though he did not specify how many processors the U.S. government believes the company possesses. Former President Trump explicitly said he does not want China to obtain Blackwell‑series AI accelerators, and U.S. officials also think DeepSeek holds such chips.

However, current U.S. rules generally allow Chinese firms to use the same chips through compute‑power leasing agreements. Kratsios claimed Moonshot AI obtained Blackwell compute power via an unnamed partner in Thailand, possibly for training Kimi K3. He also alleged the company used “distillation” techniques, training K3 on outputs from Anthropic’s Fable model to compensate for limited compute, but offered no concrete evidence.

People familiar with Moonshot AI’s procurement strategy confirmed the company does have channels to acquire Blackwell processors through Southeast Asia, though they did not clarify whether this is via legal leasing or a direct purchase that would violate U.S. rules. The Information reported this week that Moonshot AI is seeking more Blackwell chips to train its next‑generation model.

Regarding the roughly 20,000 chips supplied by Alibaba, insiders say they come from Nvidia’s previous‑generation Hopper architecture. Several sources close to Moonshot AI noted the agreement involves the most powerful Hopper chips, the H200, but an Alibaba spokesperson denied providing compute powered by H200 while also refusing to deny a collaboration involving about 20,000 Nvidia chips, and did not disclose the exact chip model.

The U.S. has approved some direct shipments of H200 chips to China, though senior U.S. officials say the actual volume is negligible. Beijing remains cautious about approving domestic purchases of H200 and is pressuring firms to switch to Huawei and other Chinese‑made chips. Chinese cloud providers have previously used overseas sites to access foreign‑owned restricted chips and then sub‑lease the compute to Chinese customers. It remains unclear where the compute power Alibaba provides to Moonshot AI is physically located.

items.title: 華爾街這次沒有被AI資本支出嚇壞 幫助亞馬遜財報公布後大漲
items.title_en: Wall Street Isn't Scared by AI Capex This Time, Boosting Amazon After Earnings Release
paras: 在科技巨頭相繼公布財報之際，半導體股周四 (30 日) 強勁反彈。輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價上漲 1.9% 至 193.66 美元，同業英特爾 (INTC-US) 與 AMD (AMD-US) 更是分別大漲 13% 和 14%。儘管市場先前對大型科技公司資本支出 (Capex) 的增長感到不安，但費城半導體指數 (SOX-US) 在連續下跌五天後，周四大漲 8%，展現出強勁的復甦動能。
亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 周四下午公布的第二季財報表現極為強勁，成為市場關注的焦點。公司當季營收達到 2010 億美元，年率增長 20%，高於預期。其每股收益為 5.75 美元，遠超去年同期的 1.68 美元與市場預估，這主要得益於對私有 AI 企業 Anthropic 持股所帶來的 530 億美元非經營性收益。
在 AI 基礎設施投入方面，亞馬遜展現了激進的姿態。執行長 Andrew Jassy 宣布將 2026 年資本支出指引從 2000 億美元上調至 2200 億美元。儘管 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 之前因類似的增支計畫導致股價受挫，亞馬遜股價在盤後交易中仍上漲近 10%，顯示投資人認可其 AI 投資的潛力。
目前 AWS 的 AI 雲需求似乎仍超過供給，公司在今年已兩度上調 AI 伺服器租賃價格。
亞馬遜雲服務 (AWS) 依然是公司的獲利引擎，本季銷售增長率達 37%，營業利潤率更提升至 39%，貢獻了全公司 61% 的營業利潤。儘管為了應對巨大的數據中心建設投入，亞馬遜正面臨連續兩季自由現金流為負，並透過新增 630 億美元的長期債務來填補資金缺口，但其廣告與訂閱業務的持續增長仍支撐了整體財務表現。
對於輝達而言，其股價回升可能與估值已降至歷史低點有關。根據數據，輝達目前的預期本益比僅為 17.53 倍，是自 2015 年 4 月以來的最低水準。在本益比偏低的前提下，股價再次上漲變得只是時間問題。
paras_en: As tech giants rolled out earnings, semiconductor stocks staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 30th). Nvidia (NVDA-US) rose 1.9% to $193.66, while peers Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) jumped 13% and 14% respectively. Although the market had been uneasy about rising capital expenditures (Capex) at large tech firms, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX-US) surged 8% on Thursday after five consecutive days of declines, showing robust recovery momentum.

Amazon (AMZN-US) posted a very strong Q2 earnings report on Thursday afternoon, becoming the market’s focal point. The company posted revenue of $201.0 billion for the quarter, up 20% year‑over‑year and beating expectations. Its earnings per share were $5.75, far above last year’s $1.68 and analyst forecasts, driven largely by a $53 billion non‑operating gain from its stake in private‑AI firm Anthropic.

On the AI‑infrastructure side, Amazon showed an aggressive stance. CEO Andrew Jassy announced that the 2026 capital‑expenditure guidance would be raised from $200 billion to $220 billion. While Alphabet (GOOGL-US) saw its stock dip after a similar spend‑up plan, Amazon’s shares rose nearly 10% in after‑hours trading, indicating investors’ confidence in its AI investments.
AWS’s AI cloud demand still appears to outstrip supply, and the company has raised AI‑server rental prices twice this year.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) remains the company’s profit engine, with sales growing 37% this quarter and operating margin climbing to 39%, contributing 61% of total operating profit. Although Amazon is facing two consecutive quarters of negative free cash flow due to massive data‑center build‑out and has tapped an additional $63 billion of long‑term debt to bridge the funding gap, continued growth in its advertising and subscription businesses is still supporting overall financial performance.

For Nvidia, the stock’s rebound may be linked to its valuation hitting historic lows. Data show Nvidia’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio is now just 17.53×, the lowest level since April 2015. With such a low P/E, another price rise is seen as only a matter of time.

items.title: 豐田6月在中國銷量銳減26.9% 連降五個月
items.title_en: Toyota's June Sales in China Plunge 26.9%, Fifth Consecutive Monthly Decline
paras: 日本汽車大廠豐田 30 日（周五）公布的產銷數據顯示，6 月在中國市場銷量為 11.53 萬輛，較一年前大幅下降 26.9%，這是豐田在華銷量連續第五個月下滑。
整個上半年，豐田在華銷量為 69.47 萬輛，比上年同期整整少賣了 14.3 萬輛車，降幅為 17.1%。
豐田在月度報告中提到，受汽油價格上漲等因素影響，嚴峻市場環境持續，銷量低於上年同期。
據《第一財經》報導，從進口車數據來看，今年 1～6 月，凌志（Lexus）銷量有 70,589 輛，累計降幅有 10%，小於豐田在華整體跌幅。
儘管凌志在進口豪華車市場中表現相對穩健，保持進口豪華車第一名，但從二季開始凌志進口車也開始進入加速下滑通道。
乘聯分會秘書長崔東樹最新分享的數據顯示，今年 6 月凌志的銷量為 10,348 輛，與前月相比，連續三個月下滑，年降 40%，擴大 2 個百分點。
paras_en: Toyota, Japan's largest automaker, announced on Friday that its sales in China for June were 115,300 units, down 26.9% from the same period last year, marking the fifth consecutive month of decline in sales in the country.
For the first half of the year, Toyota's sales in China totaled 694,700 units, a decrease of 143,000 units from the same period last year, representing a 17.1% decline.

In its monthly report, Toyota attributed the decline in sales to factors such as rising gasoline prices, which have led to a severe market environment, resulting in sales below the same period last year.
According to a report by First Financial, from January to June, Lexus sold 70,589 units, with a cumulative decline of 10%, which is smaller than Toyota's overall decline in China.

Although Lexus has performed relatively well in the imported luxury car market, maintaining its position as the number one imported luxury car brand, its imported car sales have also begun to decline rapidly since the second quarter.

Data shared by Cui Dongshu, secretary general of the China Passenger Car Association, shows that in June, Lexus sold 10,348 units, down from the previous month, marking three consecutive months of decline, with a year-over-year decline of 40%, an expansion of 2 percentage points.

items.title: 環球晶(6488)更新義大利 Novara 廠火災進度，法人估影響全球 8 吋產能約 5%
items.title_en: GlobalWafers (6488) Updates Progress on Italy Novara Plant Fire, Analysts Estimate About 5% of Global 8‑inch Capacity Affected
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 環球晶(6488-TW)於今日更新義大利 Novara 廠火災後續進展。公司表示，7月22日火災主要發生於8吋晶圓廠後段製程區域，並非整座工廠受損，全體員工均已安全撤離，無人員傷亡及環境污染。公司已投保財產綜合保險，涵蓋財產損失及營運中斷，實際理賠金額仍待保險公司評估，復工時程則須待消防及主管機關核准。
法人指出，此次停產的8吋產線約占環球晶全球8吋產能5%，預期對成熟製程矽晶圓供給帶來短期影響。不過，若受損範圍集中於部分後段製程，且並非整廠停工，實際衝擊仍有待復工進度及公司全球產能調度能力進一步觀察。
值得注意的是，本次火災影響的是既有8吋產線，並未波及Novara新建的12吋Fab300廠。Fab300是環球晶布局歐洲先進12吋矽晶圓的重要基地，也是歐洲強化半導體供應鏈自主的重要投資項目，因此此次事件不影響公司中長期在歐洲的擴產策略。
義大利北部皮埃蒙特(Piedmont)大區的Novara正快速崛起為歐洲半導體供應鏈的重要據點。隨著環球晶圓GlobalWafers(6488-TW)啟用Fab300 12吋矽晶圓廠，以及Silicon Box宣布投資32億歐元興建先進封裝廠，Novara正逐步形成涵蓋矽晶圓製造與先進封裝的完整半導體聚落，成為歐洲近年最具代表性的半導體投資中心之一。

環球晶圓Fab300正式投產補足歐洲12吋矽晶圓供應缺口
環球晶圓於2025年10月正式啟用位於義大利Novara的Fab300 12吋矽晶圓製造廠，主要生產應用於邏輯、記憶體、功率元件及通訊晶片的高品質矽晶圓。
該廠由環球晶圓旗下義大利子公司MEMC Electronic Materials S.p.A.負責營運，廠址位於義大利皮埃蒙特大區Novara市Vle Luigi Gherzi 31，延續公司過去收購MEMC／SunEdison矽晶圓業務後的既有製造基地。
Fab300除了因應全球先進晶片需求持續成長，也肩負提升歐洲半導體供應鏈自主能力的重要任務，同時導入再生能源等永續製造技術，強化環球晶圓全球生產布局。
根據產業資料，環球晶圓目前全球半導體矽材料市場占有率約7.56%，排名全球第三，僅次於信越化學Shin-Etsu Chemical(4063-JP)的12.64%，以及SUMCO(3436-JP)的7.87%。
除義大利外，公司亦於2026年2月啟用位於美國德州Sherman的新建12吋矽晶圓廠，為美國20多年來首座全新興建的矽晶圓製造基地。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – GlobalWafers (6488‑TW) updated the follow‑up on the fire at its Novara plant in Italy today. The company said the fire on July 22 was confined to the back‑end area of the 8‑inch wafer fab, not the entire facility. All staff were safely evacuated, with no injuries or environmental contamination. The firm has property and business interruption insurance covering loss of assets and operational downtime; the actual claim amount is still under assessment by the insurer, and the resumption schedule awaits approval from the fire department and regulators.

Analysts note that the halted 8‑inch line represents roughly 5% of GlobalWafers’ worldwide 8‑inch capacity, which could cause a short‑term impact on the supply of mature‑process silicon wafers. However, if damage is limited to certain back‑end steps and the whole plant is not shut down, the real impact will depend on the pace of restart and the company’s ability to re‑allocate capacity globally.

It is worth noting that the fire affected the existing 8‑inch line only and did not impact the newly built 12‑inch Fab300 in Novara. Fab300 is a key hub for GlobalWafers’ advanced 12‑inch wafer footprint in Europe and a strategic investment for strengthening Europe’s semiconductor supply‑chain autonomy, so the incident does not alter the company’s medium‑ to long‑term expansion plans in Europe.

Novara in Italy’s Piedmont region is rapidly emerging as a critical node in Europe’s semiconductor supply chain. With GlobalWafers’ Fab300 12‑inch wafer fab coming online and Silicon Box announcing a €3.2 billion investment in an advanced packaging plant, Novara is developing a full‑stack semiconductor cluster that includes wafer manufacturing and advanced packaging, making it one of Europe’s most prominent semiconductor investment centers in recent years.

GlobalWafers’ Fab300 officially began production in October 2025, filling the European 12‑inch wafer supply gap. The plant, operated by the company’s Italian subsidiary MEMC Electronic Materials S.p.A., is located at Viale Luigi Gherzi 31 in Novara, Piedmont, on the site of the former MEMC/SunEdison wafer operations that GlobalWafers acquired.

Fab300 not only meets the growing demand for advanced chips worldwide but also supports Europe’s goal of greater supply‑chain self‑sufficiency. The fab incorporates renewable‑energy and other sustainable manufacturing technologies, reinforcing GlobalWafers’ global production network.
Industry data show GlobalWafers holds about a 7.56% share of the global semiconductor silicon material market, ranking third worldwide behind Shin‑Etsu Chemical (12.64%) and SUMCO (7.87%).

Beyond Italy, the company launched a new 12‑inch wafer fab in Sherman, Texas, USA in February 2026, marking the first brand‑new wafer manufacturing facility built in the United States in more than 20 years.

items.title: 美食展「台灣觀光館」今盛大登場 展館首度規劃四大AI體驗、共54家特色品牌
items.title_en: Food Expo "Taiwan Tourism Pavilion" Grandly Opens Today, Featuring Four AI Experiences and 54 Unique Brands
paras: 2026 台灣美食展於今 (7) 年 31 日至 8 月 3 日在台北世貿舉行，交通部觀光署今年以呼應大會主題，以「台灣美 Ways，發酵中！」為主軸，在展區中的台灣觀光館，集結 54 家特色業者共襄盛舉，打造北區暨馬祖、中區暨金門、南區暨澎湖及東區四大展區，並設置永續專區及米其林必比登推介專區，更首度規劃四大 AI 體驗，讓民眾能從科技互動中探索屬於自己的台灣好風味。
展館四大 AI 體驗包括：AR 慢釀體驗艙：結合虛實整合技術，讓民眾走入巨型發酵甕，與臺灣特色景點合影。風土旅行相館：運用 AI 分析個人喜好，推薦專屬旅遊景點並生成個人化旅行明信片。風土煉金鍋：以趣味互動介紹永續旅遊與循環生活理念。都會調香師：提供茶香、海風、老酒等臺灣代表性氣味，供民眾自由調配特色香氣。
交通部長陳世凱今日出席開幕典禮時表示，盼以美食帶路，讓更多觀光客走訪各地並記住美好台灣。
今日開展當日特別邀請味全龍啦啦隊，化身「風土應援團」熱力登場；8 月 3 日則邀請主持人詹姆士帶領民眾探索展館美味亮點。現場另有中華美食交流協會名廚運用「觀光圈大賞」特色食材進行料理示範，展現臺灣美食的多元風味。
觀光署表示，展覽期間，廣受大家喜愛的台灣觀光代言人「喔熊組長」也將化身「風土釀造長」，與民眾近距離互動，展館每日還安排品牌推介會、限時優惠及消費滿額贈等活動。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan Food Expo runs from today, July 31, through August 3 at the Taipei World Trade Center. This year the Tourism Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, echoing the expo theme "Taiwan's Ways, Fermenting!", has gathered 54 specialty vendors in the Taiwan Tourism Pavilion. The pavilion is divided into four regional zones—Northern (including Matsu), Central (including Kinmen), Southern (including Penghu) and Eastern—plus a sustainability zone and a Michelin Bib Gourmand showcase. For the first time, four AI experiences have been arranged so visitors can explore Taiwan's flavors through interactive technology.

The four AI experiences are: an AR fermentation‑cask cabin that blends virtual and real elements, letting visitors step into a giant fermentation jar and pose with iconic Taiwanese landmarks; a "Local‑Flavor Travel" studio that uses AI to analyze personal preferences, recommend bespoke travel spots and generate personalized travel postcards; a "Local Alchemy" pot that uses playful interaction to introduce concepts of sustainable tourism and circular living; and an urban perfumer that offers signature Taiwanese scents such as tea, sea breeze and aged liquor for visitors to mix their own fragrances.

Minister of Transportation and Communications Chen Shih‑kai, who attended the opening ceremony today, said he hopes food will lead the way, encouraging more tourists to travel around the island and remember the beauty of Taiwan.

On opening day, the Wei‑Chuan Dragons cheerleading squad was invited to appear as the "Local‑Flavor Support Team". On August 3, host James will guide the public in exploring the pavilion’s culinary highlights. The event also features a master chef from the Chinese Culinary Exchange Association demonstrating dishes using specialty ingredients from the "Tourism Circle Awards," showcasing the diversity of Taiwanese cuisine.

The Tourism Bureau added that during the exhibition, the beloved Taiwan tourism mascot "Oh‑Bear Squad Leader" will transform into the "Local‑Flavor Brewmaster" for close‑up interactions with visitors. Each day the pavilion will host brand promotion sessions, limited‑time offers and spend‑and‑receive giveaways.

items.title: 致茂法說透露這個產業即將進入強勁循環！
items.title_en: Zhi Mao Reveals This Industry Is About to Enter a Strong Growth Cycle!
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 設備大廠致茂（2360-TW）於7月30日召開2026年第二季法說會，揭露的營收結構與新品進度，就透露出一個重要訊號：
在眾多相關細產業當中，已經有一個領域率先進入設備採購與產能擴張階段，接下來可能迎來更強勁的成長循環。

哪一項設備需求成長最快？
致茂的主要產品為量測及檢測設備，應用範圍涵蓋伺服器電源、GPU與ASIC測試、先進封裝、光通訊、BBU及儲能系統等領域。
由於公司設備橫跨多個重要供應鏈，因此，從不同產品線的營收成長與交機時程，可以進一步判斷各個細產業目前處於驗證、擴產，還是即將放量的階段。
致茂2026年第二季合併營收為135.29億元，季增14%、年增110%，連續兩季創下歷史新高；上半年合併營收達253.89億元，年增91%，每股盈餘為21.27元。
從產品組合來看，上半年量測及自動化檢測設備營收為115.59億元，年增136%；半導體與光通訊測試解決方案營收為77.96億元，年增62%。
兩項主要業務都維持高速成長，但量測及自動化檢測設備的成長幅度明顯更高，不但超過公司整體營收增幅，也遠高於半導體與光通訊測試業務。
這項業務為什麼會率先大幅成長？
主要原因來自伺服器電源、HVDC及儲能系統的測試需求快速增加。
致茂表示，AI相關需求目前已占電力電子測試營收約60%，而其中大多數都與AI資料中心的電源供應器測試有關。
答案也因此浮現。
目前在相關供應鏈中，進度走得最快、已經率先進入擴產階段的細產業，就是AI電源供應器。

AI電源設備需求已經出現，客戶相關產品正進入出貨期
過去電源供應器的生產節奏，主要跟隨伺服器出貨節奏。
但現在從設備端觀察，已經開始出現三個變化：
第一，產線規模擴大，設備需求明顯增加，代表客戶正在擴充產能。
第二，產品規格升級，測試設備功率提升至MW等級，對應更高階的生產線配置。
第三，系統整合程度提高，測試範圍從單一產品延伸到機櫃與系統層級，代表產線已進入整合與放量前階段。
這三個變化合在一起，反映的不是需求成長，而是整個AI電源供應鏈的生產節奏正在進入加速期，並且迎來規格升級。
接下來AI伺服器電源供應器、HVDC電源轉換設備以及整櫃電力系統供應商，如台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)等電源供應器大廠營運動能會比較快看到反映。

半導體後段測試客戶準備在2026年底至2027年產能爬坡
致茂的高功率老化測試設備已經接單，確定在2026年下半年出貨；多個GPU、CPU及交換器晶片客戶也將在下半年進入新品導入或量產爬坡。
但從設備進場到產線穩定運作仍需時間，因此相關供應鏈的生產節奏較可能落在2026年底至2027年才明顯加速。

BBU、儲能、光通訊測試設備下半年交付，相關供應鏈正在建置下一代新品產能
致茂的光引擎、CPO模組及雷射老化測試設備預計在2026年下半年出貨。
同時，4MW等級電池測試系統也將陸續交付，對應資料中心BBU及ESS儲能需求。
這代表相關供應鏈目前仍在產線建置與設備導入階段，生產節奏尚未進入放量期。

面板級封裝仍在客戶驗證

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Equipment giant Zhi Mao (2360‑TW) held its Q2 2026 earnings briefing on July 30. The disclosed revenue structure and new‑product progress signal an important message: among the many related sub‑industries, one sector has already entered the equipment procurement and capacity‑expansion stage and may soon usher in a stronger growth cycle.

Which equipment demand is growing the fastest? Zhi Mao’s main products are measurement and testing equipment, used in server power supplies, GPU and ASIC testing, advanced packaging, optical communications, BBU and energy‑storage systems, among others. Because the company’s equipment spans multiple critical supply chains, the revenue growth and delivery schedules of different product lines can indicate whether each sub‑industry is in a validation, expansion, or pre‑volume stage.

Zhi Mao’s consolidated revenue for Q2 2026 was NT$13.529 billion, up 14% quarter‑over‑quarter and 110% year‑over‑year, marking a historic high for the second consecutive quarter. For the first half of the year, consolidated revenue reached NT$25.389 billion, up 91% YoY, with earnings per share of NT$21.27.

By product mix, measurement and automated testing equipment generated NT$11.559 billion in the first half, a 136% YoY increase; semiconductor and optical‑communication test solutions generated NT$7.796 billion, up 62% YoY.

Both major businesses are maintaining rapid growth, but the measurement and automated testing segment is expanding markedly faster, outpacing the company’s overall revenue growth and far exceeding the semiconductor and optical‑communication testing business.

Why is this business leading the surge? The main driver is the rapid increase in testing demand for server power supplies, HVDC and energy‑storage systems. Zhi Mao notes that AI‑related demand now accounts for about 60% of its power‑electronics testing revenue, most of which relates to power‑supply testing for AI data‑center servers. The answer therefore becomes clear: the sub‑industry that is moving fastest and has already entered the expansion phase is AI power supplies.

AI power‑equipment demand has already materialised, and customers’ products are entering the shipment phase. Historically, power‑supply production followed server shipment cycles. Now three changes are evident from the equipment side: (1) Production‑line scale is expanding, driving a clear rise in equipment demand as customers boost capacity; (2) Product specifications are being upgraded, with test‑equipment power ratings climbing to the megawatt level, matching higher‑end production lines; (3) System integration is increasing, extending test scope from single products to rack‑ and system‑level, indicating the line is moving into the pre‑volume integration stage. Together these shifts reflect not just demand growth but an acceleration of the entire AI power‑supply chain’s production rhythm and a move toward higher specifications.

Going forward, AI server power supplies, HVDC power‑conversion equipment and full‑rack power‑system providers such as Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) and Lite-On (2301‑TW) are expected to see operational momentum reflected more quickly.

Back‑end semiconductor test customers are preparing for a capacity ramp‑up from late 2026 to 2027. Zhi Mao’s high‑power aging test equipment has already been ordered for shipment in the second half of 2026; several GPU, CPU and switch‑chip customers will also begin new‑product introduction or volume ramp‑up in the second half. However, time is needed from equipment installation to stable line operation, so the related supply‑chain production rhythm is likely to accelerate noticeably toward the end of 2026 and into 2027.

BBU, energy‑storage and optical‑communication test equipment are slated for delivery in the second half of 2026, and the related supply chains are building next‑generation product capacity. Zhi Mao’s optical‑engine, CPO modules and laser aging test equipment are expected to ship in H2 2026, while 4 MW‑class battery test systems will be delivered progressively to meet data‑center BBU and ESS storage needs. This indicates that these supply chains are still in the line‑construction and equipment‑introduction phase, with production not yet in the volume‑up stage.

Panel‑level advanced‑packaging measurement equipment has been installed at customer sites but remains in adjustment and trial. It is still in the line‑validation stage and has not entered a clear mass‑production rhythm.

The delivery schedule of Zhi Mao’s equipment reveals the order of customer operational phases. From revenue and delivery timing, the differences in production rhythm across sub‑industries are evident. The first phase is AI power supplies – equipment demand has expanded markedly, showing customers are in line‑expansion and integration, with production accelerating. The second phase includes back‑end semiconductor testing, optical communications, BBU and energy storage – still in equipment‑introduction and line‑construction, with production likely to strengthen gradually from late 2026 to 2027. The third phase is panel‑level packaging, still in validation and adjustment, not yet in a defined mass‑production rhythm.

Thus, the key takeaway from Zhi Mao’s briefing is not merely equipment‑demand growth but the diverging production rhythms of each sub‑industry. While the market focuses on product themes, the equipment side already reflects that the AI power‑supply chain’s production rhythm is accelerating and is the first to enter the next expansion cycle.

量測及自動化檢測設備成長最快，主要受到AI伺服器電源、HVDC及儲能系統測試需求帶動。

目前進度走得最前面的是AI伺服器電源。
此外，致茂下半年將推出3.6MW電網模擬器、2.7MW直流電子負載及1.8MW雙向直流電源，測試範圍已經從單一電源供應器，擴大到伺服器機櫃與伺服器集群。
搭配量測設備部門上半年營收年增136%，可以看出AI電源供應鏈已進入實際擴產階段。
接下來AI伺服器電源供應器、HVDC電源轉換設備以及整櫃電力系統供應商，如台達電(2308-TW)、光寶科(2301-TW)等電源供應器大廠營運動能會比較快看到反映。

半導體後段測試客戶準備在2026年底至2027年產能爬坡
致茂的高功率老化測試設備已經接單，確定在2026年下半年出貨；公司也表示，多個GPU、CPU及交換器晶片客戶將在下半年推出新品或進行量產爬坡。
依照設備下半年進場的時間推估，相關晶片、封測及測試介面供應鏈的營運動能，較可能從2026年底至2027年增強。

BBU、儲能、光通訊測試設備下半年交付，相關供應鏈正在建置下一代新品產能
致茂的光引擎、CPO模組與雷射老化測試設備預計在2026年下半年出貨。
同一時間，最高可擴充至4MW的電池測試系統也將陸續交付，需求涵蓋資料中心BBU及ESS儲能。
BBU、電池模組、電池芯、EDLC、儲能系統整合商以及CPO相關供應鏈的營運動能較可能在2026年底至2027年逐步反映。

面板級封裝仍在客戶驗證
面板級先進封裝量測設備已安裝於客戶端，正在進行調整試用。
顯示面板級封裝距離大規模量產仍有變動空間。

致茂設備交付進度透露的客戶營運順序
從致茂法說會可以整理出AI供應鏈的目前的三個營運狀態：
AI電源相關供應鏈已經進入擴產與出貨，成長動能正在發生。
半導體後段測試、光通訊、BBU及儲能客戶正在逐步新增、建置產能，營運較可能在2026年底至2027年轉強。
面板級封裝客戶仍在進行驗證，相關產品量產仍有待觀察。

paras: 智冠 (5478-TW) 今 (31) 日於「2026 ChinaJoy 中國國際數碼互動娛樂展覽會」上海 BTOB 展區亮相，以「AI 賦能一站式解方」為主題，透過 AI 工具優化全方位服務，由 MyCard 為核心入口，整合支付、流量、內容、營運與技術支援等資源，開拓數位娛樂新商機。
智冠表示，延續多年深耕數位娛樂產業的堅實基礎，今年進一步將 AI 應用在既有服務流程，讓一站式服務從「資源整合」推進至「流程優化」，將支付、流量、內容與營運資源串接成可實際執行的出海流程，以達成降低試錯、時間成本，增加效能與反應速度。
而遊戲出海落地的第一步，是讓玩家能進入應用場景、並順利完成消費，智冠表示，MyCard 作為集團旗下數位娛樂領導品牌，持續扮演一站式服務的重要入口，範疇橫跨台港澳、東南亞、南美洲等高成長市場，提供信用卡、手機帳單、電子錢包、銀行轉帳、超商付款、BNPL 等上百種支付方式，滿足玩家支付需求。
智冠集團結合 760 萬會員基礎、串接數千款遊戲與數位內容支付、通路宣傳與線下活動資源，透過全台便利商店、超市、知名餐飲等高人流實體場域，結合街頭玩家見面會與主題地推活動，協助品牌深入玩家日常場景，提升市場觸及與互動效益，協助海外廠商快速接軌玩家消費場景。
遊戲成功進入在地市場後，後續需要穩定營運、經營玩家社群與持續互動。智冠集團整合數位行銷、AI 素材應用、內容製作、客服社群、營運代操與雲端資安等資源，協助合作夥伴依據產品上市、改版活動與營運需求，建立從市場溝通、玩家經營到技術支援的完整服務鏈，讓產品持續累積價值。
面對全球遊戲市場競爭加速，智冠強調，將以 AI 應用與一站式解方整合，憑藉完整的服務鏈優勢快速回應市場需求，深化與全球遊戲開發商、發行商及數位內容夥伴的合作，協助產品從市場導入、玩家觸及、長線營運建立完整佈局，共同拓展數位娛樂產業新商機。
paras_en: iDreamSky (5478‑TW) appeared today (31st) at the Shanghai B2B zone of the 2026 ChinaJoy International Digital Interactive Entertainment Exhibition, presenting a theme of “AI‑Empowered One‑Stop Solution.” Using AI tools to optimise a full‑range of services, the company positions MyCard as the core entry point and integrates payment, traffic, content, operations and technical support resources to explore new digital‑entertainment business opportunities.

iDreamSky said that building on its many years of a solid foundation in the digital‑entertainment industry, it is this year further applying AI to its existing service processes, moving the one‑stop service from “resource integration” to “process optimisation.” By linking payment, traffic, content and operational resources into a practical overseas‑expansion workflow, the company aims to reduce trial‑and‑error and time costs while increasing efficiency and response speed.

The first step for game expansion overseas is to let players enter the application scenario and complete purchases smoothly. iDreamSky noted that MyCard, the group’s leading digital‑entertainment brand, continues to serve as an important one‑stop entry point, covering high‑growth markets such as Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, Southeast Asia and South America. It offers hundreds of payment methods—including credit cards, mobile‑bill payments, e‑wallets, bank transfers, convenience‑store payments and BNPL—to meet players’ payment needs.

Leveraging a base of 7.6 million members, connections to thousands of games and digital‑content payments, and channel promotion and offline‑event resources, iDreamSky uses high‑traffic physical venues such as convenience stores, supermarkets and well‑known restaurants across Taiwan. Combined with street‑level player meet‑ups and themed ground‑promotion activities, the company helps brands penetrate players’ daily scenes, boost market reach and interaction effectiveness, and assists overseas developers in quickly linking to player‑spending contexts.

After a game successfully enters a local market, ongoing stable operations, community management and continuous interaction are required. iDreamSky integrates digital marketing, AI‑generated assets, content creation, community customer service, operational outsourcing and cloud security resources to help partners build a complete service chain—from market communication and player management to technical support—based on product launches, version updates and operational needs, ensuring the product continuously accumulates value.

Facing accelerating competition in the global game market, iDreamSky emphasised that it will combine AI applications with its one‑stop solution, leveraging its comprehensive service‑chain advantage to respond quickly to market demand. The company aims to deepen cooperation with global game developers, publishers and digital‑content partners, assisting products in market entry, player outreach and long‑term operation to establish a complete layout and jointly expand new opportunities in the digital‑entertainment industry.

paras: 財政部所屬各地區國稅局於今 (31) 日同步辦理 114 年度綜合所得稅結算申報第 1 批退稅作業，全國退稅件數達 364 萬餘件，退稅總金額高達 610 億餘元，相較於 113 年度的退稅表現，件數增加 2 萬餘件，退稅金額更顯著增加 25 億餘元，創下歷史新高紀錄，提醒符合資格的民眾盡快刷本子確認款項是否順利入帳。
財政部臺北國稅局進一步說明，本次第 1 批綜合所得稅退稅案件的適用範圍相當廣泛，主要涵蓋三大類民眾。首先是全面採用網路申報進行結算申報的退稅案件；其次是符合綜合所得稅稅額試算服務，並且透過線上或電話語音進行確認的退稅案件；最後則是符合稅額試算資格，並在 5 月 11 日以前透過書面方式向戶籍所在地國稅局完成確認的退稅案件，以上皆納入本次首批撥款的名單之中。
在領取退稅款的方式上，國稅局指出，納稅義務人在申報時如果選擇直撥退稅是最為安全且快速的管道，退稅款會在 7 月 31 日當天直接撥入民眾指定的存款帳戶中。不過，在此批退稅案件中，仍有大約 1.48% 的民眾沒有選擇直撥轉帳退稅。針對這部分納稅人，國稅局已於同日開立紙本退稅憑單，並正陸續透過掛號郵寄方式發送，請收到憑單的民眾務必在退稅憑單兌領有效期限 9 月 30 日之前儘速前往兌領。
針對持有紙本退稅憑單的兌領細節，國稅局說明，如果憑單金額未達 5000 元，民眾可以直接攜帶國民身分證、印章以及退稅憑單，前往憑單上所指定的臺灣銀行營業單位兌領現金。
如果憑單金額在 5000 元以上但未滿 20000 元者，則必須利用金融機構或是郵局的存款帳戶提出交換來領取退稅款。
至於憑單金額達 20000 元以上者，依法規定禁止背書轉讓，僅能將該張憑單存入受退稅人在金融機構或郵局所開立的存款帳戶中。
為了讓民眾未來能更有效率地領取退稅款，國稅局特別呼籲，建議大家在辦理綜合所得稅結算申報時，多加利用直撥退稅功能，直接提供個人的存款帳戶供稽徵機關辦理轉帳作業。如此一來，不僅退稅款項可以更早入帳，更能完全不必擔心紙本退稅憑單發生遺失或是遭人冒領的風險，同時也能省去親自往返金融機構排隊提兌的時間，可說是好處非常多的便利選擇。
最後，國稅局也特別提出防詐騙提醒，強調國稅局絕對不會透過電話指示民眾操作 ATM 來辦理轉帳退稅。民眾如果對退稅程序有任何疑問，可以直接撥打免付費服務電話 0800-000321，或是向戶籍所在地所屬的國稅局分局及稽徵所進行洽詢。
paras_en: On the 31st of this month, the regional National Tax Bureaus under the Ministry of Finance simultaneously processed the first batch of 2025 comprehensive income tax settlement refunds. A total of over 3.64 million refund cases were handled nationwide, with the total refund amount exceeding NT$61 billion. Compared with the 2024 refund performance, the number of cases increased by more than 20,000 and the refund amount rose by over NT$2.5 billion, setting a new historical record. Eligible taxpayers are reminded to check their accounts promptly to confirm that the funds have been deposited.

The Taipei National Tax Bureau of the Ministry of Finance explained that the scope of this first batch of comprehensive income tax refunds is very broad, covering three main groups of taxpayers. First are those who filed their settlement entirely online. Second are taxpayers who used the tax‑amount simulation service and confirmed their refunds online or by phone. Third are taxpayers who qualified for the simulation and, before May 11, submitted written confirmation to the tax bureau in their place of household registration. All of these groups are included in the first‑batch disbursement list.

Regarding how to receive the refunds, the tax bureau noted that taxpayers who chose direct‑deposit refunds during filing used the safest and fastest channel, with the money being transferred directly into the designated bank account on July 31. However, about 1.48 % of taxpayers in this batch did not select direct‑deposit. For these individuals, the bureau issued paper refund vouchers on the same day and is mailing them by registered mail. Recipients should redeem the vouchers before the September 30 deadline.

For details on redeeming paper vouchers, the bureau explained that if the voucher amount is less than NT$5,000, taxpayers can go to the Taiwan Bank branch indicated on the voucher and receive cash by presenting their national ID, seal, and the voucher.
If the voucher amount is between NT$5,000 and NT$20,000, the taxpayer must use a bank or post office deposit account to exchange the voucher for the refund.
For voucher amounts of NT$20,000 or more, the law prohibits endorsement or transfer; the voucher can only be deposited into a bank or post office account opened in the name of the refund recipient.

To help taxpayers receive refunds more efficiently in the future, the tax bureau strongly encourages the use of the direct‑deposit option when filing the comprehensive income tax settlement, providing a personal bank account for the tax authority to transfer the funds. This not only speeds up the receipt of refunds but also eliminates the risk of losing or having paper vouchers stolen, and saves the time spent traveling to and queuing at financial institutions—a highly convenient choice.

Finally, the tax bureau issued an anti‑fraud reminder, emphasizing that it will never ask taxpayers to operate an ATM over the phone to process a refund transfer. If anyone has questions about the refund process, they can call the toll‑free number 0800‑000321 or contact the local tax bureau branch or assessment office in their place of household registration.

items.title: 下周一再新增8檔股票抓去關 ABF股王南電關至8/18處置最久
items.title_en: Eight More Stocks Added for Delisting Next Monday; ABF Leader Nandian Delisted Until August 18, the Longest Duration
paras: 台股今 (31) 日上演奇蹟日超級大反彈，終場創史上最大漲點 3,186 點，證交所與櫃買中心也新增 8 檔處置股，共 4 檔上市、4 檔上櫃股，包括南電 (3046-TW)、禾伸堂 (3026-TW)、泰宗 (4169-TW)、愛普 *(6531-TW)、光頡 (3624-TW)、合晶 (6182-TW)、竹陞科技 (6739-TW)、創新服務 (7828-TW)。南電自下周一 (8 月 3 日) 處置至 8 月 18 日最久，其餘 7 檔則關到 8 月 14 日為止。
新增 8 檔處置股中，涵蓋 ABF、被動元件、矽晶圓、半導體設備廠及生技類股。其中禾伸堂是延長處置至 8 月 14 日。
ABF 載板股王南電遭處置原因為最近 6 個營業日累積收盤價跌幅達 26.89%，且 6 個營業日起迄兩個營業日收盤價價差達 190.00 元。7 月 30 日之最近 6 個營業日之當日沖銷成交量占最近 6 個營業日總成交量比率 70.69%，且 7 月 30 日當日沖銷成交量占該日總成交量比率 79.4%。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks staged a miraculous super rebound today (the 31st), ending with a historic high gain of 3,186 points. The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market also added eight delisted stocks, four listed and four over‑the‑counter, including Nandian (3046‑TW), He Shen Tang (3026‑TW), Tai Zong (4169‑TW), iPE *(6531‑TW), Guang Jie (3624‑TW), He Jing (6182‑TW), Zhu Sheng Technology (6739‑TW) and Chuang Xin Service (7828‑TW). Nandian will be delisted from next Monday (August 3) until August 18, the longest period, while the other seven will be delisted until August 14.

Among the eight newly delisted stocks are companies in ABF, passive components, silicon wafers, semiconductor equipment and biotech sectors. He Shen Tang’s delisting period has been extended to August 14.

The ABF carrier stock leader Nandian is being delisted because over the most recent six trading days its cumulative closing‑price decline reached 26.89% and the price difference between the closing price on the sixth day and that two days later was NT$190.00. On July 30, the intraday offset‑trade volume for the most recent six trading days accounted for 70.69% of the total volume for those six days, and the offset‑trade volume on July 30 alone made up 79.4% of that day’s total volume.

He Shen Tang’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 41.27% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$190 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

Tai Zong’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 48.42% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$82.5 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

iPE’s delisting reason is a cumulative closing‑price drop of 28.15% over the most recent six trading days, with a price difference of NT$191 between the sixth day’s close and the close two days later.

Guang Jie’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 37.6% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days. Uni-President Securities’ entrusted sell volume for the security that day accounted for 32.22% of the day’s total volume, while Morgan Stanley Securities’ entrusted buy volume accounted for 31.9% of the day’s total volume.
He Jing’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 32.9% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.
Zhu Sheng Technology’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 34.8% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days.
Chuang Xin Service’s delisting reason is a cumulative decline of 31.99% in the last transaction price over the most recent six trading days, including today.

items.title: 東典光電自結6月獲利由虧轉盈 濾光片切入5G與資料中心
items.title_en: Dongdian Optoelectronics Turns June Profit Around, Expands Filter Business into 5G and Data Centers
paras: 光通訊濾光片廠東典光電 (6588-TW) 近期因股價達主管機關要求公告交易資訊標準，東典今 (31) 日公告今年 6 月份自結獲利，稅後純益為 800 萬元、每股純益為 0.22 元，皆較去 (2025) 年同期由虧轉盈。
東典光電今年上半年營收為 1.83 億元、年增達 132.45%，公司去 (2025) 年經營層重組，引進了在 AI、半導體、光電以及財務管理等各方面的專業人才，進行多產業布局，透過產品組合調整、成本控管與營運效率改善，營運將持續轉佳。
東典目前主力產品為應用於光通訊主動與被動元件、雲端資料中心的薄膜濾光片，上半年月營收明顯放量，年成長率維持高雙位數，顯示 5G 建設與資料中心需求正逐步反映在訂單動能。東典今日股價開高走高，尾盤在資金湧進下攻上漲停價 89.1 元，外資也由賣轉買。
法人指出，東典近年持續聚焦高速光通訊與 AI 資料中心應用，並深化高階光學鍍膜技術布局，目前相關產品已應用於 400G、800G 高速光模組、PON 及資料中心高速傳輸架構等領域，公司也持續投入 800G/1.6T 相關 Filter 產品，與高階光學元件開發，強化高速光通訊市場布局與產品競爭力。
paras_en: Optoelectronic filter maker Dongdian Optoelectronics (6588‑TW) recently met the regulatory threshold for mandatory disclosure of trading information. On the 31st, the company announced its June‑month earnings, reporting a net profit after tax of NT$8 million and earnings per share of NT$0.22, both turning from a loss in the same period of 2025 to a profit.

For the first half of this year, Dongdian’s revenue reached NT$183 million, a year‑over‑year increase of 132.45%. The company underwent a management reshuffle in 2025, bringing in professionals with expertise in AI, semiconductors, optoelectronics and financial management to pursue a multi‑industry strategy. Through product‑mix adjustments, cost control and operational efficiency improvements, its performance is expected to keep improving.

Dongdian’s core products are thin‑film optical filters used in active and passive components for optical communications and cloud data centers. Monthly revenue in the first half surged, maintaining a high double‑digit annual growth rate, indicating that 5G rollout and data‑center demand are gradually translating into order momentum. The stock opened higher and rose throughout the day, closing at the daily limit price of NT$89.1 as capital poured in, with foreign investors switching from selling to buying.

Analysts note that Dongdian has continued to focus on high‑speed optical communications and AI data‑center applications, deepening its advanced optical coating technology portfolio. Its related products are already deployed in 400G and 800G high‑speed optical modules, PON systems and high‑speed data‑center transmission architectures. The company is also investing in 800G/1.6T filter products and advanced optical component development to strengthen its market position and product competitiveness in the high‑speed optical communications sector.

items.title: 市場不信Fed會再升息？美債曲線出現罕見警訊
items.title_en: Market Doubts Fed Will Raise Rates Again? Rare Warning on US Treasury Curve
paras: 美國公債殖利率曲線在聯準會 (Fed) 本周決議維持利率不變後急遽陡峭化，短天期殖利率下降、長天期殖利率反而大幅走高，反映市場愈來愈懷疑 Fed 是否還會升息，也引發外界對央行抗通膨決心與政策公信力的擔憂。
Fed 主席華許本周三雖強調，若物價壓力未能緩解，決策官員將毫不猶豫採取行動，但市場反應顯示，投資人並不相信 Fed 即將啟動積極升息周期。
Fed 本周維持利率不變，儘管有 3 名官員投下反對票、主張升息。決議公布後，各天期美債殖利率最初全面下滑，反映投資人對央行未立即升息感到安心。然而，市場走勢很快出現明顯分歧，短天期殖利率持續下降，長天期公債殖利率卻急遽攀升，其中 30 年期殖利率更升至 19 年新高。

「扭轉式陡峭化」反映信心動搖

CreditSights 總體經濟與投資級債券策略主管葛里菲斯 (Zachary Griffiths) 將這種走勢形容為「扭轉式陡峭化」(twist steepener)，並稱其為市場對 Fed 決策的「不健康反應」。
殖利率曲線陡峭化走勢周四持續，2 年期與 10 年期、2 年期與 30 年期美債殖利率差距均進一步擴大。Truist Wealth 固定收益部門董事總經理休伊 (Chip Hughey) 表示，殖利率曲線的扭轉顯示，市場認為 Fed 不會展開激進升息周期。這或許有利經濟成長，卻會為 Fed 對抗通膨的行動增添更多不確定性。
分析師認為，Fed 選擇按兵不動的原因之一，是即使央行沒有進一步升息，金融情勢也已明顯收緊。華許指出，市場實際上已替 Fed 完成許多工作，投資人根據最新經濟數據調整部位，推動名目與經通膨調整後的美債殖利率同步升高，而非完全依賴 Fed 提供的政策指引。
10 年期美債殖利率 7 月以來已上升 25 個基點，創 3 月以來最大單月升幅。不過，這次曲線陡峭化並非典型的「熊市陡峭化」。一般情況下，各天期殖利率會同步上升，只是長端升幅更大；此次卻是短端下滑、長端攀升，凸顯市場對近期利率與長期通膨風險的看法正朝相反方向發展。

非農就業成 Fed 公信力考驗

殖利率曲線變陡通常代表市場正在反映未來降息，或至少不會再升息。這次走勢也顯示，投資人正在解除先前押注 Fed 將於 7 月升息，或因中東緊張情勢升高而暗示即將進一步緊縮的部位。
Fed 會議前，市場一度完全反映 9 月前升息約 25 個基點的預期，2 年期與 10 年期殖利率差則在會議前一周縮小 5 個基點。法國巴黎銀行美國利率策略主管丁格拉 (Guneet Dhingra) 表示，曲線重新陡峭化意味 Fed 在 6 月會議後建立的抗通膨公信力，已有相當大一部分流失。若央行未清楚表明升息仍是政策選項，公信力恐進一步遭到侵蝕。
Azimut Group 全球固定收益共同主管博欽 (Nicolò Bocchin) 指出，Fed 改採減少前瞻指引的新做法，讓市場感到迷失。投資人因而更加擔心通膨，並將相關風險反映在長天期公債價格上。
下周公布的 7 月非農就業報告將成為這項市場觀點的重要考驗。葛里菲斯表示，若就業數據優於預期，可能強化市場對 Fed 本周本應升息的質疑，使殖利率曲線進一步陡峭化；若數據疲弱，則可能緩解 Fed 落後通膨情勢的擔憂，促使目前走勢迅速逆轉。
paras_en: The US Treasury yield curve steepened sharply after the Federal Reserve (Fed) decided to keep rates unchanged this week, with short‑term yields falling and long‑term yields jumping, reflecting growing market skepticism that the Fed will raise rates further and raising concerns about the central bank’s anti‑inflation resolve and policy credibility.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell emphasized on Wednesday that if price pressures do not ease, policymakers will act without hesitation, but market reaction showed investors do not believe the Fed is about to start an aggressive rate‑hiking cycle.

The Fed left rates unchanged this week despite three officials voting against and urging a hike. After the decision was announced, yields across all maturities initially fell, indicating investors were reassured the central bank would not hike immediately. However, the market quickly split, with short‑term yields continuing to drop while long‑term Treasury yields surged, the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level in 19 years.
The “twist steepener” reflects waning confidence
CreditSights senior economist and investment‑grade bond strategist Zachary Griffiths described the move as a “twist steepener” and called it an “unhealthy reaction” to Fed policy decisions.

The steepening of the yield curve continued on Thursday, with the spread between 2‑year and 10‑year, and between 2‑year and 30‑year Treasuries widening further. Truist Wealth fixed‑income managing director Chip Hughey said the curve twist shows the market believes the Fed will not embark on a aggressive hiking cycle. That may be supportive of growth but adds uncertainty to the Fed’s fight against inflation.

Analysts say one reason the Fed chose to stand pat is that even without further hikes, financial conditions have already tightened noticeably. Powell noted that the market has effectively done much of the Fed’s work, with investors adjusting positions based on the latest data, pushing both nominal and inflation‑adjusted Treasury yields higher rather than relying solely on Fed guidance.

The 10‑year Treasury yield has risen 25 basis points since July, the biggest monthly gain since March. However, this steepening is not a typical “bear‑steepening.” Normally, yields across maturities rise together, with the long end moving more; this time the short end fell while the long end rose, highlighting a shift in market views on near‑term rates versus long‑term inflation risk.

Yield‑curve steepening usually signals the market is pricing in future rate cuts or at least no more hikes. This move also shows investors are shedding bets that the Fed would hike in July or that Middle‑East tensions would prompt further tightening.

Ahead of the Fed meeting, the market had fully priced in about a 25‑basis‑point hike before September, and the 2‑year/10‑year spread had narrowed by five basis points in the week before the meeting. BNP Paribas US rates strategist Guneet Dhingra said the renewed steepening means a sizable portion of the credibility the Fed built after the June meeting has already eroded. If the central bank does not clearly signal that hikes remain an option, credibility could be further damaged.

Azimut Group global fixed‑income co‑head Nicolò Bocchin noted that the Fed’s shift to less forward guidance has left the market disoriented. Investors are therefore more worried about inflation and are reflecting that risk in long‑term Treasury prices.

The July non‑farm payrolls report due next week will be a key test of this market view. Griffiths said that if employment data come in stronger than expected, it could reinforce doubts that the Fed should have raised rates this week and push the yield curve even steeper; weaker data could ease concerns that the Fed is lagging behind inflation and trigger a rapid reversal of the current trend.

items.title: AbbVie財報優於預期，但併購拖累2026年獲利展望
items.title_en: AbbVie Beats Estimates, but Acquisition Dampens 2026 Profit Outlook
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AbbVie(ABBV-US)第二季財報優於市場預期，主要受惠於新一代免疫疾病藥物 Skyrizi 和 Rinvoq 持續強勁成長。不過，由於6月宣布收購Apogee Therapeutics，公司小幅下修2026年獲利預測，盤前股價一度下跌近4%。
這次收購金額高達109億美元，是AbbVie五年多來最大的一筆併購，目的是擴大異位性皮膚炎（濕疹）、氣喘等發炎性疾病的新藥產品線。
AbbVie表示，這筆交易預計將使2026年每股盈餘減少0.14美元，但既有業務的成長可抵銷其中0.10美元，因此實際影響約為每股0.04美元。
雖然公司調降明年獲利預測，但第二季營運表現依然亮眼。第二季營收達169.9億美元，高於市場預估的167.7億美元；調整後每股盈餘為3.65美元，也優於市場預估的3.60美元。
產品表現方面，曾經的明星藥物Humira因生物相似藥競爭，營收年減36%至7.56億美元，不過仍高於市場預估的7.324億美元。
相較之下，新一代免疫疾病藥物持續成為主要成長動能。其中，Skyrizi營收年增24.4%至55.1億美元，優於市場預估的54.5億美元；Rinvoq營收年增24.5%至25.3億美元，也高於市場預估的24.8億美元。
不過，市場焦點已從「財報是否優於預期」，轉向「成長是否足以支撐目前股價」。分析師指出，AbbVie股價自4月低點以來已反彈約30%，自6月宣布收購Apogee以來也上漲約18%。在市場期待已經偏高的情況下，即使財報略優於預期，仍未必足以推動股價持續上漲。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – AbbVie (ABBV-US) posted second‑quarter results that beat market expectations, driven mainly by continued strong growth of its next‑generation immunology drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq. However, after announcing the acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics in June, the company slightly lowered its 2026 earnings outlook, and the pre‑market stock fell nearly 4% at one point.

The deal, valued at $10.9 billion, is AbbVie’s largest acquisition in more than five years and is intended to broaden its pipeline of new treatments for inflammatory diseases such as atopic dermatitis (eczema) and asthma.

AbbVie said the transaction is expected to reduce 2026 earnings per share by $0.14, but growth in its existing businesses will offset $0.10 of that impact, leaving a net effect of about $0.04 per share.

Although the company cut its profit forecast for next year, the second‑quarter operating performance remained impressive. Q2 revenue reached $16.99 billion, above the market estimate of $16.77 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $3.65, also topping the consensus estimate of $3.60.
On the product side, the former blockbuster Humira saw revenue fall 36% year‑over‑year to $756 million due to biosimilar competition, but it still beat the market estimate of $732.4 million.

By contrast, the next‑generation immunology drugs continued to be the main growth drivers. Skyrizi’s revenue grew 24.4% year‑over‑year to $5.51 billion, ahead of the $5.45 billion forecast, while Rinvoq’s revenue rose 24.5% to $2.53 billion, also above the $2.48 billion estimate.

However, market focus has shifted from “whether the earnings beat expectations” to “whether growth is sufficient to support the current stock price.” Analysts note that AbbVie’s share price has rebounded about 30% since its April low and has risen roughly 18% since the June announcement of the Apogee deal. With expectations already elevated, even a modest earnings beat may not be enough to sustain further price gains.

items.title: 蘋果財測不如預期，AI資料中心搶晶片拖累供應鏈，股價重挫近10%
items.title_en: Apple Forecast Misses Expectations, AI Data Center Chip Rush Burdens Supply Chain, Stock Plummets Nearly 10%
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果公布最新財報後，雖然上一季業績表現穩健，但對本季的展望不如市場預期，加上供應鏈吃緊問題持續，導致股價週五一度重挫近10%。
如果跌幅維持至收盤，將創下蘋果自2020年3月疫情引發市場崩跌以來最大單日跌幅，市值更可能蒸發近5,000億美元，並將全球市值第一大公司的寶座重新讓給輝達。
即將於9月卸任執行長、轉任執行董事長的庫克表示，目前零組件短缺情況「非常嚴重」，即使是蘋果，也已經沒有太多方法可以改善供應問題。
造成供應鏈緊張的主因，是全球科技巨頭持續投入AI資料中心建設，大量搶購先進晶片製造產能與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）等記憶體產品，導致整體供應吃緊、價格上漲，並開始擠壓智慧型手機和個人電腦市場的零組件供應。
蘋果過去一段時間靠著提前建立庫存，暫時抵銷部分記憶體漲價帶來的衝擊。不過，庫克坦言，這些庫存緩衝已逐漸消耗殆盡，目前處理器供應不足，已經影響iPhone和Mac的出貨能力，即使市場需求仍然強勁，也無法完全滿足。
蘋果預估本季營收將年增9%至11%，低於華爾街預估約12%的成長幅度。此外，服務業務成長放緩，也讓投資人感到擔憂。
服務業務包括App Store、Apple Music、Apple TV+等，是蘋果近年重要的獲利來源。分析師認為，若蘋果按照市場預期，在9月新款iPhone發表時調漲售價，未來iPhone銷量可能受到影響，進一步拖累服務業務成長。
摩根士丹利分析師指出，蘋果對供應鏈的掌控能力正受到考驗，而AI目前也尚未明顯帶動產品或服務成長，未來能否透過AI創造更多獲利仍存在不確定性。
財報公布後，至少有四家券商下調蘋果目標價，三家則調升。根據市場共識統計，目前市場目標價中位數為330美元，比前一個交易日收盤價低3美元。不過，截至週四收盤，蘋果股價今年仍累計上漲22.7%。
