paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After Apple released its latest earnings, the previous quarter’s performance was solid, but its outlook for the current quarter fell short of market expectations, and ongoing supply‑chain tightness pushed the stock down almost 10% on Friday.

If the decline holds through the close, it would mark Apple’s biggest single‑day drop since the market crash triggered by the March 2020 pandemic, potentially erasing about $500 billion in market value and handing the title of world’s most valuable company back to Nvidia.
Tim Cook, who will step down as CEO in September to become executive chairman, said the component shortage is "extremely severe" and that even Apple has few levers left to alleviate the supply issue.

The main driver of the supply crunch is the continued investment by global tech giants in AI data centers, which are snapping up advanced chip‑fabrication capacity and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) products, tightening overall supply, pushing up prices and beginning to squeeze component availability for smartphones and PCs.

Apple had previously built up inventory in advance, temporarily offsetting some of the impact of rising memory prices. However, Cook admitted those inventory buffers are now largely depleted, and processor shortages are already affecting iPhone and Mac shipment capacity; even strong market demand cannot be fully met.
Apple projects this quarter’s revenue to grow 9%‑11% year‑over‑year, below Wall Street’s roughly 12% growth expectation. In addition, a slowdown in services growth has raised investor concerns.

Services, which include the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+ and others, have become a key profit driver for Apple in recent years. Analysts warn that if Apple follows market expectations and raises iPhone prices at the September launch, future iPhone sales could be hit, further dragging down services growth.

Morgan Stanley analysts note that Apple’s control over its supply chain is being tested, and AI has yet to clearly drive product or service growth; it remains uncertain whether AI can generate additional profit for Apple in the future.

After the earnings release, at least four brokerages cut Apple’s target price while three raised it. According to market consensus, the median target price is now $330, $3 below the previous day’s closing price. Nonetheless, as of Thursday’s close, Apple’s stock is still up 22.7% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 華爾街開始挑AI贏家！亞馬遜開盤狂飆逾13%、蘋果慘跌近9%
items.title_en: Wall Street Starts Picking AI Winners! Amazon Soars Over 13% at Open, Apple Plummets Nearly 9%
paras: 亞馬遜與蘋果周五 (31 日) 開盤股價走勢呈現巨大反差，亞馬遜暴漲逾 13%，蘋果則重挫近 9%，顯示投資人正根據企業財報與人工智慧 (AI) 策略，挑選新一輪科技股贏家。
截稿前，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 周五盤中股價上漲 13.52%，每股暫報 267.34 美元；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 盤中股價下跌 8.63%，每股暫報 304.64 美元。
兩家公司均於周四盤後公布第二季財報。蘋果獲利、營收及 iPhone 銷售額全數優於市場預期，但本季財測疲弱，成為股價遭到拋售的主因。
蘋果預估，本季營收將成長 9% 至 11%，低於 LSEG 調查分析師預期的 12%。公司表示，供應限制正在影響成長，除了關鍵零組件記憶體嚴重短缺外，先進晶片製造產能競爭也日益激烈。
供應吃緊已促使蘋果調高 Mac 與 iPad 售價，分析師預期 iPhone 也可能於今年漲價。儘管市場需求依然強勁，投資人仍擔心成本升高及供貨不足，將限制蘋果短期營收成長。
相較之下，亞馬遜第二季雲端運算業務營收年增 37%，創 2021 年以來最快增速。亞馬遜網路服務 (AWS) 是公司大部分 AI 相關營收的主要來源，其強勁表現反映企業對 AI 產品及運算資源的需求持續升溫。
亞馬遜同時將今年資本支出預估由 2,000 億美元調高至 2,200 億美元，持續擴建 AI 基礎設施。市場近期愈來愈擔心大型科技公司投資速度超越實際需求，但 AWS 的高速成長，讓投資人相信亞馬遜的龐大支出能夠帶來回報。
Forrester 首席分析師 Tracy Woo 表示，AWS 的強勁成長清楚顯示，亞馬遜的基礎設施投資正在滿足市場需求，而非過度超前部署。
亞馬遜今年以來股價表現相對落後，即使計入周五漲幅，累計僅上漲約 4%；蘋果同期則上漲 23%。蘋果先前因未大舉擴張 AI 資本支出，被視為重金投資 AI 科技巨頭的替代選擇，但這項優勢如今受到供應瓶頸考驗。
大型科技股走勢正隨 AI 策略明顯分歧。Meta(META-US)周四重挫 8%，微軟 (MSFT-US) 卻大漲 15%，加上亞馬遜與蘋果周五走勢分歧，顯示投資人不再全面追捧科技股，而是更重視 AI 支出能否轉化為實際營收與獲利。
paras_en: Amazon and Apple showed a stark contrast in opening price movements on Friday (the 31st), with Amazon surging more than 13% while Apple slumped nearly 9%, indicating that investors are selecting the next round of tech winners based on corporate earnings and artificial intelligence (AI) strategies.
Before the deadline, Amazon (AMZN-US) was up 13.52% during Friday’s session, briefly trading at $267.34 per share; Apple (AAPL-US) was down 8.63%, briefly at $304.64 per share.

Both companies released their Q2 earnings after Thursday’s market close. Apple’s profit, revenue and iPhone sales all beat market expectations, but a weak outlook for the current quarter became the main driver of the stock’s sell‑off.

Apple forecasts current‑quarter revenue growth of 9% to 11%, below the 12% expected by LSEG analysts. The company said supply constraints are curbing growth, with severe shortages of key memory components and increasingly fierce competition for advanced chip‑making capacity.

Tight supply has already forced Apple to raise prices for Macs and iPads, and analysts expect iPhone prices could also rise this year. Although market demand remains strong, investors worry that higher costs and insufficient supply will limit Apple’s short‑term revenue growth.

In contrast, Amazon’s Q2 cloud computing revenue grew 37% year‑over‑year, the fastest pace since 2021. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the main source of the company’s AI‑related revenue, and its strong performance reflects sustained corporate demand for AI products and compute resources.

Amazon also raised its capital‑expenditure outlook for the year from $200 billion to $220 billion, continuing to expand AI infrastructure. While markets have grown increasingly concerned that big‑tech spending may outpace actual demand, AWS’s rapid growth reassures investors that Amazon’s massive outlays can deliver returns.
Forrester chief analyst Tracy Woo said AWS’s robust growth clearly shows that Amazon’s infrastructure investments are meeting market demand rather than being over‑built.

Amazon’s stock has lagged this year; even with Friday’s jump, it’s up only about 4% year‑to‑date, whereas Apple is up 23% over the same period. Apple was previously seen as an alternative to heavy‑spending AI giants because it had not aggressively expanded AI capital spending, but that advantage is now being tested by supply bottlenecks.

Big‑tech stock moves are diverging sharply based on AI strategies. Meta (META-US) fell 8% on Thursday, while Microsoft (MSFT-US) surged 15%, and the opposite moves of Amazon and Apple on Friday show investors are no longer uniformly chasing tech stocks but are focusing on whether AI spending can translate into real revenue and profit.

items.title: 微軟AI戰略轉向 終於讓投資人不再因OpenAI而看衰股價
items.title_en: Microsoft Shifts AI Strategy, Relieving Investor Concerns Over OpenAI-Driven Stock Decline
paras: 科技巨頭微軟 (MSFT-US) 在最新的第四財季業績電話會議中，為人工智慧 (AI) 領域的投資者傳遞了一個至關重要的信號：企業級 AI 的未來可能不再僅僅取決於某個「單一基礎模型」，而是屬於那些提供強大技術支援的「基礎設施提供商」。
微軟執行長納德拉 (Satya Nadella) 在業績會議上多次強調，微軟目前的戰略核心是「賦予客戶訪問多種 AI 模型的權利」，代表微軟不再綁死 OpenAI。
雖然微軟與 OpenAI 的合作關係仍受矚目，但納德拉明確表示，微軟的生態系統不僅包含 OpenAI 的 GPT 系列，還廣泛納入包括 Anthropic、xAI、Mistral 以及微軟自家的 MAI 系列模型。
目前，微軟旗下的雲端服務平台 Azure 已能提供超過 11,000 個 AI 模型供客戶選擇。
數據顯示，企業端對於「多供應商模型」的需求正呈現爆炸式增長，利用來自多個提供商的模型來構建應用程式的客戶數量，在近期增長了五倍之多。這種「平台化」與「多樣化」的趨勢，顯示出企業在部署 AI 時，更傾向於選擇能提供多元整合與穩定基礎設施的合作夥伴，而非將所有籌碼押在單一模型上。
對於 ETF 投資者而言，這一趨勢意味著市場重心正在發生位移。過去，市場主要關注誰能開發出「最強模型」；然而，隨著模型競爭進入白熱化，能夠支持這些模型運行、運算與整合的「基礎設施」反而成為更穩定的投資目標。
這一轉向顯示，微軟的轉型對 AI 基礎設施 ETF 的利好，可能已經超過了直接投資或押注 OpenAI。當企業不再只依賴單一模型，而是需要一個強大的環境來測試、訓練與執行不同的 AI 應用時，微軟、輝達 (NVDA-US) 等提供雲端算力與平台服務的企業，其護城河將變得更加穩固。
在業績公佈後，相關科技股表現分化。微軟股價表現強勁，漲幅達 15.51%，顯示市場對其 AI 基礎設施戰略的認可。與此同時，作為基礎設施核心的晶片龍頭輝達也上漲了 2.65%，進一步印證了基礎設施商在 AI 浪潮中的受益地位。相較之下，其他科技巨頭如 Meta(META-US) 則出現了 7.95% 的跌幅，顯示市場正在重新評估各家公司在 AI 產業鏈中的定位。
paras_en: Tech giant Microsoft (MSFT-US) signaled a crucial message to AI investors during its latest Q4 earnings call: the future of enterprise AI may no longer hinge on a single foundational model, but on those that act as robust infrastructure providers.
CEO Satya Nadella repeatedly emphasized that Microsoft’s strategic core now is “empowering customers to access a variety of AI models,” indicating the company is no longer locked into OpenAI.

While Microsoft’s partnership with OpenAI remains in the spotlight, Nadella made clear that Microsoft’s ecosystem includes not only OpenAI’s GPT series but also models from Anthropic, xAI, Mistral and Microsoft’s own MAI series.
Microsoft’s Azure cloud platform now offers customers access to more than 11,000 AI models.

Data shows enterprise demand for “multi‑vendor models” is exploding, with the number of customers building applications using models from multiple providers having surged five‑fold recently. This platform‑centric, diversified trend shows enterprises prefer partners that provide broad integration and stable infrastructure rather than betting on a single model.

For ETF investors, the trend signals a shift in market focus. Previously the market chased whoever could develop the “strongest model”; now, as model competition intensifies, the “infrastructure” that supports, computes and integrates those models becomes a more stable investment target.

This pivot suggests Microsoft’s transformation benefits AI‑infrastructure ETFs more than direct bets on OpenAI. As enterprises move away from reliance on a single model and need a powerful environment to test, train and run diverse AI applications, companies like Microsoft and Nvidia (NVDA-US) that supply cloud compute and platform services see their moats solidify.

After the earnings release, tech stocks moved in divergent directions. Microsoft’s share price jumped 15.51%, reflecting market approval of its AI‑infrastructure strategy. At the same time, chip leader Nvidia, a core infrastructure player, rose 2.65%, further confirming the benefit to infrastructure providers in the AI wave. By contrast, other tech giants such as Meta (META-US) fell 7.95%, indicating the market is re‑evaluating each company’s position in the AI value chain.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉亞馬遜與晶片股領漲 主要指數開高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as Amazon and Chip Stocks Lead Gains
paras: 美股周五 (31 日) 開高，科技股延續前一日反彈氣勢，那斯達克指數連續第二個交易日走揚。亞馬遜公布強勁財報，雲端業務營收成長優於預期，緩解市場對人工智慧 (AI) 龐大投資回報的疑慮，激勵股價開盤大漲約 12%，抵銷蘋果因財測不如預期而重挫的壓力。
與此同時，資金持續回補 7 月遭大幅拋售的晶片股，帶動科技類股全面走強，華爾街在震盪劇烈的 7 月最後一個交易日展開強勁反攻。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近 210 點或 0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數漲近 280 點或 1.1%，標普 500 指數漲 0.6%，費城半導體指數漲近 4.2%。台積電 ADR 漲近 2.5%。
科技股周五全面反彈，晶片股延續升勢，亞馬遜股價更大漲 10%，帶動市場以相對樂觀的氣氛結束 7 月交易。先前最受追捧的人工智慧 (AI) 交易在本月遭遇劇烈估值修正，但企業財報展現強勁獲利能力，緩解投資人對 AI 投資回報的疑慮。
南韓股市率先點燃全球科技股反攻行情，南韓綜合股價指數 (KOSPI) 史無前例暴漲 18%，記憶體晶片大廠 SK 海力士觸及 30% 漲停限制。那斯達克 100 指數期貨上漲 0.9%，標普 500 指數期貨漲 0.2%，追蹤晶片類股的 ETF 在美股早盤上漲 3.3%。歐洲 Stoxx 600 指數則觸及歷史新高。
不過，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 因營收展望不如預期，股價重挫 7.6%，成為科技股反彈中的少數例外。

AI 交易洗牌告一段落

本周稍晚的反彈，讓經歷 7 月晶片股大幅下殺的投資人暫時鬆一口氣。市場人士認為，AI 避險基金 Situational Awareness 被迫出售投資部位，是先前相關股票持續承壓的原因之一。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 本周稍早公布強勁財報後，市場逐漸回穩。亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 隨後公布，旗下雲端運算部門創下 2021 年以來最快單季成長速度，讓投資人相信，公司預計 2026 年投入 2,200 億美元資本支出，將能產生回報並支撐全球 AI 基礎設施建設。
Lombard Odier Investment Managers 策略師耶爾波 (Florian Ielpo) 表示，最嚴重的部位清洗可能已經結束，科技股估值較一個月前合理，但仍稱不上便宜。他認為，這並不代表 AI 交易走到盡頭，而是最容易賺錢的階段可能已經結束。
《彭博》策略師博伊德 (Sebastian Boyd) 指出，這是多年來美國企業表現最亮眼的財報季，尤其科技公司在 AI 熱潮帶動下，獲利普遍大幅超越預期，顯示近期晶片股跌勢可能已經過頭。

Fed、油價與日元牽動 8 月行情

中東局勢持續緊張，布蘭特原油上漲 1.4%，突破每桶 90 美元。伊朗國營媒體 IRIB News 報導，6 艘油輪在荷姆茲海峽遭到阻擋；裏海石油管線聯盟也預計於周五稍晚決定，是否因水道安全疑慮而無限期停止營運。
美債短天期殖利率走高，30 年期殖利率則大致持平於 5.21%。美國第二季就業成本增幅略高於市場預期，美元上漲 0.4%。Fed 本周在通膨仍高於目標之際維持利率不變後，長天期美債殖利率升至多年高點，貨幣政策後續走向持續受到市場關注。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack) 與明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 均警告，若 Fed 遲遲不採取行動，未來可能被迫祭出更激烈的緊縮政策。兩人也是本周反對維持利率不變的 3 名官員之一。

paras_en: U.S. stocks opened higher on Friday (the 31st), with technology shares continuing the rebound momentum from the previous day, sending the Nasdaq index up for a second consecutive session. Amazon reported a strong earnings report, with cloud revenue growth beating expectations, easing market concerns about the massive investment returns from artificial intelligence (AI) and spurring the stock to jump about 12% at the open, offsetting pressure from Apple’s sharp drop after its earnings fell short of forecasts.

At the same time, investors kept adding to chip stocks that had been heavily sold off in July, lifting the broader tech sector and prompting a strong counter‑attack on Wall Street on the last, volatile trading day of July.

By the time of writing, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up about 210 points, or 0.4%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 280 points, or 1.1%, the S&P 500 gained 0.6%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed roughly 4.2%. TSMC ADR was up nearly 2.5%.

Technology stocks rebounded across the board on Friday, chip stocks kept climbing, and Amazon surged another 10%, helping the market close July on a relatively optimistic note. The AI‑related trades that had been the most chased earlier this month suffered a sharp valuation correction, but strong corporate earnings eased investors’ worries about AI investment returns.

South Korea’s market sparked the global tech rally, with the KOSPI soaring an unprecedented 18% and memory‑chip giant SK Hynix hitting the 30% daily limit. Nasdaq‑100 futures rose 0.9%, S&P 500 futures were up 0.2%, and an ETF tracking chip stocks gained 3.3% in early U.S. trading. Europe’s Stoxx 600 hit a record high.
However, Apple (AAPL-US) fell 7.6% after its revenue outlook missed expectations, becoming one of the few exceptions in the tech rebound.
AI‑trade reshuffling winds down

The later‑week rebound gave investors who saw chip stocks plunge in July a brief sigh of relief. Market participants said that the forced liquidation of the AI‑hedge fund Situational Awareness was one reason related stocks had stayed under pressure.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) steadied the market after posting a strong earnings report earlier in the week. Amazon (AMZN-US) then disclosed that its cloud division posted the fastest quarterly growth since 2021, convincing investors that the company’s planned $220 billion of capital expenditures by 2026 would generate returns and support global AI infrastructure building.

Lombard Odier Investment Managers strategist Florian Ielpo said the most severe position clean‑up may be over, and tech valuations are now more reasonable than a month ago, though still not cheap. He added that this does not signal the end of AI trading, but rather that the easiest profit‑making phase may have passed.

Bloomberg strategist Sebastian Boyd noted this has been the brightest earnings season for U.S. companies in years, especially tech firms whose AI‑driven profits largely beat expectations, suggesting the recent chip‑stock decline may have been overdone.
Fed, oil and yen shape August outlook

Middle‑East tensions kept Brent crude up 1.4%, breaking $90 a barrel. Iran’s state media IRIB News reported six tankers blocked in the Hormuz Strait; the Caspian oil‑pipeline alliance is expected to decide later Friday whether to suspend operations indefinitely over waterway‑security concerns.

U.S. short‑term Treasury yields rose while the 30‑year rate held around 5.21%. U.S. Q2 employment‑cost growth was slightly above expectations, pushing the dollar up 0.4%. After the Fed left rates unchanged despite inflation staying above target, long‑term Treasury yields climbed to multi‑year highs, keeping monetary‑policy direction in focus.

Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack and Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari warned that if the Fed delays action, it may have to resort to more aggressive tightening later. Both were among three officials this week who opposed keeping rates steady.

The Bank of Japan left rates unchanged and Governor Kazuo Ueda offered no further yen‑support signals, leaving the yen to wobble around flat. Bloomberg estimated the BOJ could spend about $52.8 billion on currency intervention on Thursday.

Going into August, whether inflation, rate expectations and the AI growth story can persist will continue to steer markets. Investors will watch the 30‑year Treasury yield, now near 5.2%, and July’s inflation data due on August 12. Ielpo cautioned that August trading is usually thin and that ordinary economic releases could trigger outsized volatility, with market anxiety potentially exceeding what fundamentals justify.

Stock focus: Chevron (CVX-US) rose 1.49% in early trading to $195.17 a share. Chevron’s pre‑market move was modest; the energy giant posted Q2 results with profit and revenue both beating expectations, net income hitting $12.1 billion, nearly a 400% jump from a year earlier.
ExxonMobil (XOM-US) fell 1.48% in early trading to $154.65 a share. Exxon’s pre‑market price slipped 2%; its Q2 adjusted EPS was $3.52, below LSEG analysts’ $3.60 estimate.

Moderna (MRNA-US) rose 0.60% in early trading to $58.27 a share. Moderna’s pre‑market price fell more than 4% despite Q2 results beating Wall Street forecasts. The company posted a loss of $1.97 per share on revenue of $145 million, better than analysts’ loss estimate of $2.03 per share and revenue estimate of $102.9 million, and its full‑year revenue outlook was also above expectations.

Wall Street analysis: Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio said the market now shows some characteristics of historic bubbles. While AI has revolutionary potential to reshape production, investors may be overlooking the gap between technological value and market price. When asset valuations far exceed actual earnings power, a tightening funding environment could quickly expose bubble risks.

Regarding investment strategy, Dalio advises investors to avoid concentrating wealth in a single asset and to diversify across stocks, cash, gold, bonds and real estate, as each performs differently across economic cycles, and a balanced mix can improve resilience to uncertainty.

items.title_en: Backer Behind Kimi K3 Revealed! Alibaba Supplies 20,000 Nvidia Chips for Compute Power
paras: 中國 AI 新創月之暗面 (Moonshot AI) 與阿里巴巴集團 (BABA-US)(09988-HK) 簽署算力合作協議，可使用約 2 萬顆輝達 (NVDA-US) 晶片，其中相當大一部分算力用於開發 Kimi 系列模型，凸顯即使美國持續收緊出口管制，中國 AI 產業仍高度依賴西方先進半導體。
外媒周五 (31 日) 援引知情人士消息報導，這批硬體構成月之暗面整體算力的重要部分。月之暗面本月稍早推出開源 AI 模型 Kimi K3，部分性能指標已逼近 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等美國領先業者的模型，引發華府、華爾街與矽谷高度關注，市場擔心中國 AI 公司正迅速縮小與美國頂尖實驗室的差距。
月之暗面、阿里巴巴與輝達均拒絕評論相關合作。

阿里雲算力養出強勁對手

阿里巴巴是月之暗面最大投資人之一，並期望被投資公司使用旗下雲端服務。但雙方同時也是 AI 市場競爭對手，如今月之暗面利用阿里巴巴提供的基礎設施開發 Kimi，卻在多項重要性能指標上超越阿里巴巴自家的通義千問 (Qwen) 模型。
知情人士表示，兩支 AI 團隊取得的訓練資源相近，Kimi K3 表現領先因此令部分阿里巴巴內部人士感到失望。這也形成微妙局面：阿里巴巴一方面透過投資及雲端服務扶植中國 AI 新創，另一方面卻可能親手培養出威脅自身產品的競爭者。
Kimi K3 的突破令人聯想到 DeepSeek 去年帶來的震撼，也重新引發市場對西方 AI 基礎設施投資效益的討論。美國科技公司正投入數千億美元，興建裝滿高階 AI 加速器的資料中心；中國企業在取得先進晶片受限的情況下，卻依然開發出逼近美國頂尖模型的產品，讓投資人開始質疑龐大硬體支出是否必然能轉化為技術領先。

華府指控取得 Blackwell 晶片

白宮科技政策辦公室主任克拉齊奧斯 (Michael Kratsios) 上周指控，月之暗面非法取得輝達最先進的 Blackwell 晶片，但並未說明美國政府認為該公司擁有多少顆處理器。川普曾明確表示，不希望中國取得 Blackwell 系列 AI 加速器；美國官員也認為 DeepSeek 持有相關晶片。
不過，美國現行規則通常允許中國企業透過算力租賃協議使用相同晶片。克拉齊奧斯聲稱，月之暗面透過泰國某個未具名合作方取得 Blackwell 算力，並可能用於訓練 Kimi K3。他另指控月之暗面運用「蒸餾」技術，使用 Anthropic 旗下 Fable 模型產生的輸出訓練 K3，以彌補算力資源不足，但沒有提出具體證據。
熟悉月之暗面採購策略的人士證實，該公司確實有管道透過東南亞取得 Blackwell 處理器，但未說明是合法的算力租賃，或違反美國規定的直接購買。《The Information》本周則報導，月之暗面正尋求更多 Blackwell 晶片，準備訓練下一代模型。
至於阿里巴巴提供的約 2 萬顆晶片，知情人士稱其來自輝達上一代 Hopper 架構。多名接近月之暗面的人士指出，協議涉及 Hopper 系列中性能最強的 H200 晶片，但阿里巴巴發言人否認向月之暗面提供以 H200 驅動的算力，卻未否認雙方存在約 2 萬顆輝達晶片規模的算力合作，也拒絕透露實際晶片型號。
美國已核准部分 H200 直接銷往中國，但美國高層官員近期表示，實際出貨數量微不足道。北京也對批准國內企業購買 H200 態度保留，並施壓業者改用華為等中國本土晶片。中國雲端業者過去曾透過海外據點使用外國企業持有的受限晶片，再將算力轉租給中國客戶。阿里巴巴提供給月之暗面的算力究竟位於何處，目前仍不清楚。
paras_en: China AI startup Moonshot AI and Alibaba Group (BABA-US)(09988-HK) have signed a compute‑power cooperation agreement that allows the use of about 20,000 Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips, a large portion of which will be devoted to developing the Kimi series models. This highlights that, despite tightening U.S. export controls, China’s AI industry remains heavily dependent on advanced Western semiconductors.

Foreign media reported on Friday (the 31st) that insiders say this batch of hardware forms a key part of Moonshot AI’s overall compute capacity. Earlier this month Moonshot AI launched the open‑source AI model Kimi K3, whose performance metrics are already approaching those of leading U.S. firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic, drawing intense attention from Washington, Wall Street and Silicon Valley. The market worries that Chinese AI firms are rapidly closing the gap with top U.S. labs.
Moonshot AI, Alibaba and Nvidia all declined to comment on the collaboration.
Alibaba Cloud Fuels a Strong Competitor

Alibaba is one of Moonshot AI’s biggest investors and hopes the investee will use its cloud services. At the same time the two are rivals in the AI market. Now Moonshot AI is using Alibaba‑provided infrastructure to develop Kimi, yet on several important performance indicators it outperforms Alibaba’s own Tongyi Qwen model.

Insiders say the two AI teams have comparable training resources, and Kimi K3’s lead performance has disappointed some Alibaba staff. This creates a delicate situation: Alibaba supports Chinese AI startups through investment and cloud services, while potentially nurturing a competitor that threatens its own products.

Kimi K3’s breakthrough evokes the shock caused by DeepSeek last year and reignites debate over the return on Western AI infrastructure spending. U.S. tech firms are pouring hundreds of billions of dollars into data centers packed with high‑end AI accelerators; Chinese companies, despite limited access to advanced chips, are still building products that approach the top U.S. models, prompting investors to question whether massive hardware outlays necessarily translate into technological leadership.
Washington Accuses Acquisition of Blackwell Chips

White House technology policy chief Michael Kratsios last week accused Moonshot AI of illegally obtaining Nvidia’s most advanced Blackwell chips, though he did not specify how many processors the U.S. government believes the company possesses. Former President Trump explicitly said he does not want China to obtain Blackwell‑series AI accelerators, and U.S. officials also think DeepSeek holds such chips.

However, current U.S. rules generally allow Chinese firms to use the same chips through compute‑power leasing agreements. Kratsios claimed Moonshot AI obtained Blackwell compute power via an unnamed partner in Thailand, possibly for training Kimi K3. He also alleged the company used “distillation” techniques, training K3 on outputs from Anthropic’s Fable model to compensate for limited compute, but offered no concrete evidence.

People familiar with Moonshot AI’s procurement strategy confirmed the company does have channels to acquire Blackwell processors through Southeast Asia, though they did not clarify whether this is via legal leasing or a direct purchase that would violate U.S. rules. The Information reported this week that Moonshot AI is seeking more Blackwell chips to train its next‑generation model.

Regarding the roughly 20,000 chips supplied by Alibaba, insiders say they come from Nvidia’s previous‑generation Hopper architecture. Several sources close to Moonshot AI noted the agreement involves the most powerful Hopper chips, the H200, but an Alibaba spokesperson denied providing compute powered by H200 while also refusing to deny a collaboration involving about 20,000 Nvidia chips, and did not disclose the exact chip model.

The U.S. has approved some direct shipments of H200 chips to China, though senior U.S. officials say the actual volume is negligible. Beijing remains cautious about approving domestic purchases of H200 and is pressuring firms to switch to Huawei and other Chinese‑made chips. Chinese cloud providers have previously used overseas sites to access foreign‑owned restricted chips and then sub‑lease the compute to Chinese customers. It remains unclear where the compute power Alibaba provides to Moonshot AI is physically located.

items.title_en: Wall Street Isn't Scared by AI Capex This Time, Boosting Amazon After Earnings Release
paras: 在科技巨頭相繼公布財報之際，半導體股周四 (30 日) 強勁反彈。輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價上漲 1.9% 至 193.66 美元，同業英特爾 (INTC-US) 與 AMD (AMD-US) 更是分別大漲 13% 和 14%。儘管市場先前對大型科技公司資本支出 (Capex) 的增長感到不安，但費城半導體指數 (SOX-US) 在連續下跌五天後，周四大漲 8%，展現出強勁的復甦動能。
亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 周四下午公布的第二季財報表現極為強勁，成為市場關注的焦點。公司當季營收達到 2010 億美元，年率增長 20%，高於預期。其每股收益為 5.75 美元，遠超去年同期的 1.68 美元與市場預估，這主要得益於對私有 AI 企業 Anthropic 持股所帶來的 530 億美元非經營性收益。
在 AI 基礎設施投入方面，亞馬遜展現了激進的姿態。執行長 Andrew Jassy 宣布將 2026 年資本支出指引從 2000 億美元上調至 2200 億美元。儘管 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 之前因類似的增支計畫導致股價受挫，亞馬遜股價在盤後交易中仍上漲近 10%，顯示投資人認可其 AI 投資的潛力。
目前 AWS 的 AI 雲需求似乎仍超過供給，公司在今年已兩度上調 AI 伺服器租賃價格。
亞馬遜雲服務 (AWS) 依然是公司的獲利引擎，本季銷售增長率達 37%，營業利潤率更提升至 39%，貢獻了全公司 61% 的營業利潤。儘管為了應對巨大的數據中心建設投入，亞馬遜正面臨連續兩季自由現金流為負，並透過新增 630 億美元的長期債務來填補資金缺口，但其廣告與訂閱業務的持續增長仍支撐了整體財務表現。
對於輝達而言，其股價回升可能與估值已降至歷史低點有關。根據數據，輝達目前的預期本益比僅為 17.53 倍，是自 2015 年 4 月以來的最低水準。在本益比偏低的前提下，股價再次上漲變得只是時間問題。
paras_en: As tech giants rolled out earnings, semiconductor stocks staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 30th). Nvidia (NVDA-US) rose 1.9% to $193.66, while peers Intel (INTC-US) and AMD (AMD-US) jumped 13% and 14% respectively. Although the market had been uneasy about rising capital expenditures (Capex) at large tech firms, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX-US) surged 8% on Thursday after five consecutive days of declines, showing robust recovery momentum.

Amazon (AMZN-US) posted a very strong Q2 earnings report on Thursday afternoon, becoming the market’s focal point. The company posted revenue of $201.0 billion for the quarter, up 20% year‑over‑year and beating expectations. Its earnings per share were $5.75, far above last year’s $1.68 and analyst forecasts, driven largely by a $53 billion non‑operating gain from its stake in private‑AI firm Anthropic.

On the AI‑infrastructure side, Amazon showed an aggressive stance. CEO Andrew Jassy announced that the 2026 capital‑expenditure guidance would be raised from $200 billion to $220 billion. While Alphabet (GOOGL-US) saw its stock dip after a similar spend‑up plan, Amazon’s shares rose nearly 10% in after‑hours trading, indicating investors’ confidence in its AI investments.
AWS’s AI cloud demand still appears to outstrip supply, and the company has raised AI‑server rental prices twice this year.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) remains the company’s profit engine, with sales growing 37% this quarter and operating margin climbing to 39%, contributing 61% of total operating profit. Although Amazon is facing two consecutive quarters of negative free cash flow due to massive data‑center build‑out and has tapped an additional $63 billion of long‑term debt to bridge the funding gap, continued growth in its advertising and subscription businesses is still supporting overall financial performance.

For Nvidia, the stock’s rebound may be linked to its valuation hitting historic lows. Data show Nvidia’s forward price‑to‑earnings ratio is now just 17.53×, the lowest level since April 2015. With such a low P/E, another price rise is seen as only a matter of time.

items.title: 市場不信Fed會再升息？美債曲線出現罕見警訊
items.title_en: Market Doubts Fed Will Raise Rates Again? Rare Warning on US Treasury Curve
paras: 美國公債殖利率曲線在聯準會 (Fed) 本周決議維持利率不變後急遽陡峭化，短天期殖利率下降、長天期殖利率反而大幅走高，反映市場愈來愈懷疑 Fed 是否還會升息，也引發外界對央行抗通膨決心與政策公信力的擔憂。
Fed 主席華許本周三雖強調，若物價壓力未能緩解，決策官員將毫不猶豫採取行動，但市場反應顯示，投資人並不相信 Fed 即將啟動積極升息周期。
Fed 本周維持利率不變，儘管有 3 名官員投下反對票、主張升息。決議公布後，各天期美債殖利率最初全面下滑，反映投資人對央行未立即升息感到安心。然而，市場走勢很快出現明顯分歧，短天期殖利率持續下降，長天期公債殖利率卻急遽攀升，其中 30 年期殖利率更升至 19 年新高。

「扭轉式陡峭化」反映信心動搖

CreditSights 總體經濟與投資級債券策略主管葛里菲斯 (Zachary Griffiths) 將這種走勢形容為「扭轉式陡峭化」(twist steepener)，並稱其為市場對 Fed 決策的「不健康反應」。
殖利率曲線陡峭化走勢周四持續，2 年期與 10 年期、2 年期與 30 年期美債殖利率差距均進一步擴大。Truist Wealth 固定收益部門董事總經理休伊 (Chip Hughey) 表示，殖利率曲線的扭轉顯示，市場認為 Fed 不會展開激進升息周期。這或許有利經濟成長，卻會為 Fed 對抗通膨的行動增添更多不確定性。
分析師認為，Fed 選擇按兵不動的原因之一，是即使央行沒有進一步升息，金融情勢也已明顯收緊。華許指出，市場實際上已替 Fed 完成許多工作，投資人根據最新經濟數據調整部位，推動名目與經通膨調整後的美債殖利率同步升高，而非完全依賴 Fed 提供的政策指引。
10 年期美債殖利率 7 月以來已上升 25 個基點，創 3 月以來最大單月升幅。不過，這次曲線陡峭化並非典型的「熊市陡峭化」。一般情況下，各天期殖利率會同步上升，只是長端升幅更大；此次卻是短端下滑、長端攀升，凸顯市場對近期利率與長期通膨風險的看法正朝相反方向發展。

非農就業成 Fed 公信力考驗

殖利率曲線變陡通常代表市場正在反映未來降息，或至少不會再升息。這次走勢也顯示，投資人正在解除先前押注 Fed 將於 7 月升息，或因中東緊張情勢升高而暗示即將進一步緊縮的部位。
Fed 會議前，市場一度完全反映 9 月前升息約 25 個基點的預期，2 年期與 10 年期殖利率差則在會議前一周縮小 5 個基點。法國巴黎銀行美國利率策略主管丁格拉 (Guneet Dhingra) 表示，曲線重新陡峭化意味 Fed 在 6 月會議後建立的抗通膨公信力，已有相當大一部分流失。若央行未清楚表明升息仍是政策選項，公信力恐進一步遭到侵蝕。
Azimut Group 全球固定收益共同主管博欽 (Nicolò Bocchin) 指出，Fed 改採減少前瞻指引的新做法，讓市場感到迷失。投資人因而更加擔心通膨，並將相關風險反映在長天期公債價格上。
下周公布的 7 月非農就業報告將成為這項市場觀點的重要考驗。葛里菲斯表示，若就業數據優於預期，可能強化市場對 Fed 本周本應升息的質疑，使殖利率曲線進一步陡峭化；若數據疲弱，則可能緩解 Fed 落後通膨情勢的擔憂，促使目前走勢迅速逆轉。
paras_en: The US Treasury yield curve steepened sharply after the Federal Reserve (Fed) decided to keep rates unchanged this week, with short‑term yields falling and long‑term yields jumping, reflecting growing market skepticism that the Fed will raise rates further and raising concerns about the central bank’s anti‑inflation resolve and policy credibility.

Fed Chair Jerome Powell emphasized on Wednesday that if price pressures do not ease, policymakers will act without hesitation, but market reaction showed investors do not believe the Fed is about to start an aggressive rate‑hiking cycle.

The Fed left rates unchanged this week despite three officials voting against and urging a hike. After the decision was announced, yields across all maturities initially fell, indicating investors were reassured the central bank would not hike immediately. However, the market quickly split, with short‑term yields continuing to drop while long‑term Treasury yields surged, the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level in 19 years.
The “twist steepener” reflects waning confidence
CreditSights senior economist and investment‑grade bond strategist Zachary Griffiths described the move as a “twist steepener” and called it an “unhealthy reaction” to Fed policy decisions.

The steepening of the yield curve continued on Thursday, with the spread between 2‑year and 10‑year, and between 2‑year and 30‑year Treasuries widening further. Truist Wealth fixed‑income managing director Chip Hughey said the curve twist shows the market believes the Fed will not embark on a aggressive hiking cycle. That may be supportive of growth but adds uncertainty to the Fed’s fight against inflation.

Analysts say one reason the Fed chose to stand pat is that even without further hikes, financial conditions have already tightened noticeably. Powell noted that the market has effectively done much of the Fed’s work, with investors adjusting positions based on the latest data, pushing both nominal and inflation‑adjusted Treasury yields higher rather than relying solely on Fed guidance.

The 10‑year Treasury yield has risen 25 basis points since July, the biggest monthly gain since March. However, this steepening is not a typical “bear‑steepening.” Normally, yields across maturities rise together, with the long end moving more; this time the short end fell while the long end rose, highlighting a shift in market views on near‑term rates versus long‑term inflation risk.

Yield‑curve steepening usually signals the market is pricing in future rate cuts or at least no more hikes. This move also shows investors are shedding bets that the Fed would hike in July or that Middle‑East tensions would prompt further tightening.

Ahead of the Fed meeting, the market had fully priced in about a 25‑basis‑point hike before September, and the 2‑year/10‑year spread had narrowed by five basis points in the week before the meeting. BNP Paribas US rates strategist Guneet Dhingra said the renewed steepening means a sizable portion of the credibility the Fed built after the June meeting has already eroded. If the central bank does not clearly signal that hikes remain an option, credibility could be further damaged.

Azimut Group global fixed‑income co‑head Nicolò Bocchin noted that the Fed’s shift to less forward guidance has left the market disoriented. Investors are therefore more worried about inflation and are reflecting that risk in long‑term Treasury prices.

The July non‑farm payrolls report due next week will be a key test of this market view. Griffiths said that if employment data come in stronger than expected, it could reinforce doubts that the Fed should have raised rates this week and push the yield curve even steeper; weaker data could ease concerns that the Fed is lagging behind inflation and trigger a rapid reversal of the current trend.

items.title: AbbVie財報優於預期，但併購拖累2026年獲利展望
items.title_en: AbbVie Beats Estimates, but Acquisition Dampens 2026 Profit Outlook
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AbbVie(ABBV-US)第二季財報優於市場預期，主要受惠於新一代免疫疾病藥物 Skyrizi 和 Rinvoq 持續強勁成長。不過，由於6月宣布收購Apogee Therapeutics，公司小幅下修2026年獲利預測，盤前股價一度下跌近4%。
這次收購金額高達109億美元，是AbbVie五年多來最大的一筆併購，目的是擴大異位性皮膚炎（濕疹）、氣喘等發炎性疾病的新藥產品線。
AbbVie表示，這筆交易預計將使2026年每股盈餘減少0.14美元，但既有業務的成長可抵銷其中0.10美元，因此實際影響約為每股0.04美元。
雖然公司調降明年獲利預測，但第二季營運表現依然亮眼。第二季營收達169.9億美元，高於市場預估的167.7億美元；調整後每股盈餘為3.65美元，也優於市場預估的3.60美元。
產品表現方面，曾經的明星藥物Humira因生物相似藥競爭，營收年減36%至7.56億美元，不過仍高於市場預估的7.324億美元。
相較之下，新一代免疫疾病藥物持續成為主要成長動能。其中，Skyrizi營收年增24.4%至55.1億美元，優於市場預估的54.5億美元；Rinvoq營收年增24.5%至25.3億美元，也高於市場預估的24.8億美元。
不過，市場焦點已從「財報是否優於預期」，轉向「成長是否足以支撐目前股價」。分析師指出，AbbVie股價自4月低點以來已反彈約30%，自6月宣布收購Apogee以來也上漲約18%。在市場期待已經偏高的情況下，即使財報略優於預期，仍未必足以推動股價持續上漲。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – AbbVie (ABBV-US) posted second‑quarter results that beat market expectations, driven mainly by continued strong growth of its next‑generation immunology drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq. However, after announcing the acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics in June, the company slightly lowered its 2026 earnings outlook, and the pre‑market stock fell nearly 4% at one point.

The deal, valued at $10.9 billion, is AbbVie’s largest acquisition in more than five years and is intended to broaden its pipeline of new treatments for inflammatory diseases such as atopic dermatitis (eczema) and asthma.

AbbVie said the transaction is expected to reduce 2026 earnings per share by $0.14, but growth in its existing businesses will offset $0.10 of that impact, leaving a net effect of about $0.04 per share.

Although the company cut its profit forecast for next year, the second‑quarter operating performance remained impressive. Q2 revenue reached $16.99 billion, above the market estimate of $16.77 billion; adjusted earnings per share were $3.65, also topping the consensus estimate of $3.60.
On the product side, the former blockbuster Humira saw revenue fall 36% year‑over‑year to $756 million due to biosimilar competition, but it still beat the market estimate of $732.4 million.

By contrast, the next‑generation immunology drugs continued to be the main growth drivers. Skyrizi’s revenue grew 24.4% year‑over‑year to $5.51 billion, ahead of the $5.45 billion forecast, while Rinvoq’s revenue rose 24.5% to $2.53 billion, also above the $2.48 billion estimate.

However, market focus has shifted from “whether the earnings beat expectations” to “whether growth is sufficient to support the current stock price.” Analysts note that AbbVie’s share price has rebounded about 30% since its April low and has risen roughly 18% since the June announcement of the Apogee deal. With expectations already elevated, even a modest earnings beat may not be enough to sustain further price gains.

items.title: 蘋果財測不如預期，AI資料中心搶晶片拖累供應鏈，股價重挫近10%
items.title_en: Apple Forecast Misses Expectations, AI Data Center Chip Rush Burdens Supply Chain, Stock Plummets Nearly 10%
paras: 2026年07月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果公布最新財報後，雖然上一季業績表現穩健，但對本季的展望不如市場預期，加上供應鏈吃緊問題持續，導致股價週五一度重挫近10%。
如果跌幅維持至收盤，將創下蘋果自2020年3月疫情引發市場崩跌以來最大單日跌幅，市值更可能蒸發近5,000億美元，並將全球市值第一大公司的寶座重新讓給輝達。
即將於9月卸任執行長、轉任執行董事長的庫克表示，目前零組件短缺情況「非常嚴重」，即使是蘋果，也已經沒有太多方法可以改善供應問題。
造成供應鏈緊張的主因，是全球科技巨頭持續投入AI資料中心建設，大量搶購先進晶片製造產能與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）等記憶體產品，導致整體供應吃緊、價格上漲，並開始擠壓智慧型手機和個人電腦市場的零組件供應。
蘋果過去一段時間靠著提前建立庫存，暫時抵銷部分記憶體漲價帶來的衝擊。不過，庫克坦言，這些庫存緩衝已逐漸消耗殆盡，目前處理器供應不足，已經影響iPhone和Mac的出貨能力，即使市場需求仍然強勁，也無法完全滿足。
蘋果預估本季營收將年增9%至11%，低於華爾街預估約12%的成長幅度。此外，服務業務成長放緩，也讓投資人感到擔憂。
服務業務包括App Store、Apple Music、Apple TV+等，是蘋果近年重要的獲利來源。分析師認為，若蘋果按照市場預期，在9月新款iPhone發表時調漲售價，未來iPhone銷量可能受到影響，進一步拖累服務業務成長。
摩根士丹利分析師指出，蘋果對供應鏈的掌控能力正受到考驗，而AI目前也尚未明顯帶動產品或服務成長，未來能否透過AI創造更多獲利仍存在不確定性。
財報公布後，至少有四家券商下調蘋果目標價，三家則調升。根據市場共識統計，目前市場目標價中位數為330美元，比前一個交易日收盤價低3美元。不過，截至週四收盤，蘋果股價今年仍累計上漲22.7%。

paras_en: July 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After Apple released its latest earnings, the previous quarter’s performance was solid, but its outlook for the current quarter fell short of market expectations, and ongoing supply‑chain tightness pushed the stock down almost 10% on Friday.

If the decline holds through the close, it would mark Apple’s biggest single‑day drop since the market crash triggered by the March 2020 pandemic, potentially erasing about $500 billion in market value and handing the title of world’s most valuable company back to Nvidia.
Tim Cook, who will step down as CEO in September to become executive chairman, said the component shortage is "extremely severe" and that even Apple has few levers left to alleviate the supply issue.

The main driver of the supply crunch is the continued investment by global tech giants in AI data centers, which are snapping up advanced chip‑fabrication capacity and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) products, tightening overall supply, pushing up prices and beginning to squeeze component availability for smartphones and PCs.

Apple had previously built up inventory in advance, temporarily offsetting some of the impact of rising memory prices. However, Cook admitted those inventory buffers are now largely depleted, and processor shortages are already affecting iPhone and Mac shipment capacity; even strong market demand cannot be fully met.
Apple projects this quarter’s revenue to grow 9%‑11% year‑over‑year, below Wall Street’s roughly 12% growth expectation. In addition, a slowdown in services growth has raised investor concerns.

Services, which include the App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+ and others, have become a key profit driver for Apple in recent years. Analysts warn that if Apple follows market expectations and raises iPhone prices at the September launch, future iPhone sales could be hit, further dragging down services growth.

Morgan Stanley analysts note that Apple’s control over its supply chain is being tested, and AI has yet to clearly drive product or service growth; it remains uncertain whether AI can generate additional profit for Apple in the future.

After the earnings release, at least four brokerages cut Apple’s target price while three raised it. According to market consensus, the median target price is now $330, $3 below the previous day’s closing price. Nonetheless, as of Thursday’s close, Apple’s stock is still up 22.7% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 日元空頭小心了！日本傳一夜砸530億美元強勢護盤 規模恐創紀錄
items.title_en: Short Sellers of the Yen Beware! Japan Deploys $53 Billion Overnight to Strongly Support the Currency, Potentially Setting a Record Scale
paras: 日本政府昨日 (30 日) 可能斥資約 530 億美元進場干預匯市、支撐日元，規模有望創下東京當局單日干預的歷史新高，凸顯日本遏制投機性日元空單的決心，但也反映當局阻止日元貶值面臨愈來愈大的難度。
《彭博》根據日本銀行 (日本央行 / BOJ) 周五 (31 日) 公布的帳戶資料，以及貨幣市場經紀商的預測分析，日本此次干預金額估計約達 8.45 兆日元 (約 528 億美元)。日本官員尚未證實是否進場，但一名知情市場人士透露，日本確實採取行動支撐日圓，美國當局也在東京時間凌晨 2 時 30 分左右進行匯率詢價。
日元周四在紐約交易時段一度兌美元大漲 3.3%，創 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中升幅。市場另傳出日本與南韓可能協調干預匯市，《路透》報導，南韓也在紐約時段賣出美元，推動韓元一度升至去年 10 月中旬以來最高水準。
不過，日銀周五決議維持政策利率不變後，日元回吐部分漲幅，東京晚間交易時段報約 1 美元兌 159.95 日元。
日本財務省財務官三村淳拒絕證實是否干預，但暗示日本當局獲得包括美國在內的其他國家支持。若相關推估屬實，這將是日本自 4 月底黃金周期間以來首度進場干預。當時日本當局單月動用創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元，但財務省尚未公布各交易日的實際金額。
日銀周五公布的周一經常帳戶餘額預測顯示，受到財政因素影響，餘額預計減少 8.2 兆日元，與東京短資、中央短資及上田八木短資原先預估將增加的方向相反。日銀首次公布的經常帳戶餘額預測，通常被市場視為推算匯市干預規模最可靠的線索。
paras_en: The Japanese government may have spent about $53 billion yesterday (the 30th) to intervene in the foreign‑exchange market and support the yen, a scale that could set a new record for a single‑day intervention by Tokyo authorities. This underscores Japan’s determination to curb speculative short positions on the yen, but also highlights the growing difficulty of preventing yen depreciation.

According to Bloomberg, based on account data released by the Bank of Japan on Friday (the 31st) and forecasts from money‑market brokers, the amount of this intervention is estimated at roughly ¥8.45 trillion (about $52.8 billion). Japanese officials have not confirmed whether they entered the market, but a market source familiar with the matter said Japan did act to support the yen, and U.S. authorities also made a rate inquiry around 2:30 a.m. Tokyo time.

On Thursday, the yen surged 3.3% against the dollar during the New York trading session, the biggest intraday gain since December 2023. There were also reports that Japan and South Korea might coordinate FX interventions; Reuters said South Korea sold dollars during the New York session, pushing the won up to its highest level since mid‑October last year.
However, after the Bank of Japan left its policy rate unchanged on Friday, the yen gave back part of its gains, trading around ¥159.95 per dollar in the Tokyo evening session.

Japan’s Finance Ministry senior official Jun Mimura declined to confirm any intervention, but hinted that Japanese authorities have backing from other countries, including the United States. If the estimates are accurate, this would be Japan’s first intervention since the end of April’s “golden period,” when authorities used a record ¥11.73 trillion in a single month, though the ministry has not disclosed the exact daily amounts.

The BOJ’s forecast for the current‑account balance released on Friday shows an expected decline of ¥8.2 trillion due to fiscal factors, opposite to the earlier expectations of an increase from short‑term capital flows. The BOJ’s first‑time publication of a current‑account forecast is usually seen by the market as the most reliable clue for estimating the scale of FX interventions.

items.title: 日銀總裁釋放強烈鷹派訊號：對物價上行風險保持「前所未有」的警惕
items.title_en: BOJ Governor Sends Strong Hawkish Signal: Unprecedented Vigilance on Inflation Risks
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周五 (31 日) 表示，隨著基調物價上漲率逐步向 2% 的穩定目標靠攏，「物價上行風險」已成為政策制定的核心考量。他強調，過去物價距離目標尚遠時，預測誤差的代價不高，但在當前環境下，若通膨顯著超出預期，將對日本經濟產生嚴重的負面影響。
在周五的政策會議上，日銀以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，植田在會後重申潛在通膨率超過 2% 目標的風險，並強調了將通膨率維持在 2% 左右的重要性。
針對近期日元疲軟，植田表示，匯率波動對物價的影響力正在擴大，並將其與中東局勢、AI 相關需求並列為未來決策的關鍵分析因素。他強調日銀將努力避免陷入「落後於曲線」的困境，若經濟與物價走勢符合預期，且金融環境維持過度寬鬆，日銀極有可能加快升息步伐。

分析師解讀：9 月或 10 月升息機率上升

儘管日銀此次並未直接調整利率，但多數策略師將植田的發言解讀為具備「實質鷹派」色彩。
摩根大通策略師 Ikue Saito 指出，日銀上修了通膨展望，且植田提到下次會議將進行「深入討論」，這顯示 9 月升息的可能性依然存在。
伊藤忠總研的武田淳則認為，植田對物價風險的強調超乎預期，原本預計 12 月的追加升息時程極可能提前至 10 月。
雖然部分投資者因植田未給出具體的時間表而一度視其為「鴿派」，導致日元出現短暫賣壓，但 SMBC 日興證券的丸山凜途分析，植田反覆強調 2% 以上的上行風險，實際上展現了強烈的鷹派底色。
部分專家如 T&D 資產管理的浪岡優指出，日銀內部的政策共識似乎變得更加困難。儘管政府與日銀可能透過干預手段支撐日元，但若日銀被視為「不情願的升息者」，日元的貶值壓力恐將持續存在。
paras_en: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Friday (the 31st) that as the core inflation rate gradually moves toward the 2% stability target, the "inflation upside risk" has become a core consideration in policy making. He stressed that when inflation was far from the target, the cost of forecast errors was low, but in the current environment, a significant overshoot of inflation would have serious negative effects on the Japanese economy.

At Friday's policy meeting, the BOJ voted overwhelmingly 8‑to‑1 to keep the policy rate unchanged at 1.0%. After the meeting, Ueda reiterated the risk that underlying inflation could exceed the 2% target and emphasized the importance of keeping inflation around 2%.

Regarding the recent yen weakness, Ueda said that exchange‑rate fluctuations are increasingly influencing prices, and he listed the Middle‑East situation and AI‑related demand as key factors for future decision‑making. He stressed that the BOJ will work to avoid falling "behind the curve" and, if the economy and price trends align with expectations and the financial environment remains overly accommodative, the BOJ could accelerate rate hikes.
Analysts' take: Higher odds of a rate hike in September or October
Although the BOJ did not change rates this time, most strategists interpreted Ueda's remarks as having a "substantially hawkish" tone.

JPMorgan strategist Ikue Saito noted that the BOJ has upgraded its inflation outlook and that Ueda mentioned a "deep discussion" at the next meeting, indicating that a September hike remains possible.
Jun Takeda of Itochu Research believes Ueda's emphasis on price risks exceeds expectations and that the previously expected December additional hike could be moved up to October.

While some investors briefly saw Ueda as "dovish" because he gave no concrete timetable, causing short‑term selling pressure on the yen, SMBC Nikko Securities analyst Rinto Maruyama argues that Ueda's repeated emphasis on upside risks above 2% actually shows a strong hawkish undertone.

Experts such as Yu Nagasaka of T&D Asset Management point out that internal policy consensus at the BOJ appears to be becoming more difficult. Even if the government and the BOJ intervene to support the yen, if the BOJ is seen as a "reluctant rate‑raiser," depreciation pressure on the yen is likely to persist.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙漲！強升1.62角收32.292元 單月仍狂貶4.55角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Both Rise! Strong Jump of 1.62 ¢ to 32.292, Still Down 4.55 ¢ for the Month
paras: 美股 30 日全面大漲，帶動亞洲股匯今 (31) 日報復性反彈，台股飆漲逾 3000 點，新台幣兌美元升幅逐漸擴大，終場強升 1.62 角或 0.5%，創逾 3 個月以來單日最大升幅，收在 32.292 元，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值放大至 40.49 億美元。
新台幣兌美元匯率今天強勢走升，一口氣衝破 32.4、32.3 元兩道關卡，收在 32.292 元，本周累計升值 6.6 分或 0.2%，中止連五周收黑；7 月累計仍狂貶 4.55 角或 1.4%，月線寫下連二黑。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數大跌 0.87%，主要亞幣展開強勁的反彈攻勢，其中，日元狂飆 2.2% 最猛，新加坡幣勁揚 0.71%，韓元升值 0.64%，新台幣亦強升 0.50%，人民幣升值 0.14%。
台北股匯今日上演報復性反彈，台積電罕見攻上漲停，達到 2425 元，上漲 220 元，創史上最大漲點，帶動台股大漲 3186.45 點，收在 43119.75 點，同創史上最大漲點紀錄。
paras_en: U.S. stocks surged across the board on the 30th, driving a retaliatory rebound in Asian equities and currencies on the 31st. The Taiwan stock index jumped over 3,000 points, and the New Taiwan dollar (NTD) against the U.S. dollar continued to appreciate, ending the day up 1.62 ¢ (about 0.5%), the largest single‑day gain in more than three months, closing at 32.292 NTD. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets expanded to USD 4.049 billion.

The NTD/USD rate rose strongly today, breaking through the 32.4 and 32.3 NTD thresholds and closing at 32.292 NTD. For the week, the currency appreciated a cumulative 6.6 ¢ (0.2%), ending a five‑week streak of declines. However, for July it is still down a sharp 4.55 ¢ (1.4%), marking the second consecutive negative day for the month.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar, the central bank’s data show the U.S. dollar index fell 0.87%, while key Asian currencies staged strong rebound attacks. The Japanese yen surged the most at 2.2%, the Singapore dollar rose 0.71%, the Korean won gained 0.64%, the New Taiwan dollar strengthened 0.50%, and the Chinese yuan appreciated 0.14%.

Taipei’s stock and currency markets staged a retaliatory rebound today. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) unusually hit its daily price‑limit ceiling at 2,425 NTD, up 220 NTD, the biggest point gain in its history, propelling the Taiwan index up 3,186.45 points to close at 43,119.75 points, tying the record for the largest single‑day rise.

items.title: 日本央行維持利率不變 下修通膨預期但保留後續升息空間
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged, Lowers Inflation Forecast but Leaves Room for Future Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行在周五 (31 日) 的金融政策決定會議上，以 8 比 1 的壓倒性多數票數決定將政策利率維持在 1.0% 不變 ，此舉反映出日銀在 6 月升息後，傾向於觀察其對經濟與物價情勢的影響，並對中東衝突與日元匯率保持謹慎態度。
受周五決定的影響，日元走弱，美元兌日元匯率上漲 0.7%。
在本次會議中，審議委員高田創是唯一的反對者。他提議將利率提高至 1.25% 左右，認為隨著海外金融政策轉向及國內物價上行風險增加，日本已進入需要機動調整政策的「新階段」，但此案最終被多數否決。
根據日銀同步發布的「經濟與物價情勢展望報告」，政策委員將 2026 年度實質國內總生產 (GDP) 人工智慧 (AI) 相關需求的增加，以及政府補助政策對國內消費的支撐。
在物價方面，2026 年度的核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 預測則從原先的 2.8% 下修至 2.5%。這主要是受到東京政府實施公用事業補貼的影響，短期內減緩了通膨壓力。然而，日銀指出，隨著薪資與物價良性循環的維持，基調物價預計在 2026 年底至 2027 年度趨於 2% 的目標水準。
儘管本次維持利率不變，日銀強調若經濟與物價展望如期實現，將繼續提高政策利率，以調整金融寬鬆程度。日銀特別提到，日元貶值及 AI 帶動的半導體價格上漲，仍可能導致物價「上行風險」大於下行風險，甚至有超越 2% 目標的可能性。
市場分析師對此持鷹派解讀，凱投宏觀 (Capital Economics) 分析指出，日銀的評論暗示後續仍有升息可能，預測下一次行動可能落在 10 月，且利率有望在明年底達到 2%。日銀未來將密切關注中東局勢、匯率波動及 AI 產業動向，做為調整政策節奏的依據。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan decided to keep its policy interest rate unchanged at 1.0% with an overwhelming majority of 8 to 1 at its monetary policy meeting on Friday, reflecting its intention to observe the impact of its previous rate hike in June on the economy and prices, and to remain cautious about the Middle East conflict and yen exchange rate.
The decision led to a weakening of the yen, with the dollar-yen exchange rate rising 0.7% on Friday.

The only dissenter in the meeting was committee member Takashi Kadota, who proposed raising the interest rate to around 1.25%, citing the need for flexible policy adjustments as Japan enters a 'new phase' with increasing risks of higher prices at home and a shift in overseas monetary policies, but his proposal was rejected by the majority.

According to the 'Economic and Price Outlook' report released by the Bank of Japan at the same time, policymakers expect the increase in demand related to artificial intelligence (AI) and government subsidy policies to support domestic consumption in the 2026 fiscal year.

In terms of prices, the forecast for the core consumer price index (CPI) in the 2026 fiscal year was revised down from 2.8% to 2.5%, mainly due to the impact of the Tokyo government's implementation of public utility subsidies, which has eased inflationary pressure in the short term. However, the Bank of Japan pointed out that with the maintenance of a virtuous cycle of wages and prices, the underlying inflation rate is expected to approach the 2% target level by the end of 2026 to 2027.

Although the interest rate was left unchanged this time, the Bank of Japan emphasized that if the economic and price outlook is as expected, it will continue to raise policy interest rates to adjust the degree of monetary easing. The Bank of Japan particularly noted that the depreciation of the yen and the rise in semiconductor prices driven by AI may still lead to 'upside risks' to prices, even exceeding the 2% target.

Market analysts took a hawkish view of this, with Capital Economics analysts pointing out that the Bank of Japan's comments suggest that there is still a possibility of further rate hikes, predicting that the next action may come in October, and that interest rates are expected to reach 2% by the end of next year. The Bank of Japan will closely watch the situation in the Middle East, exchange rate fluctuations, and trends in the AI industry as the basis for adjusting the pace of policy.

items.title: 日元狂升500點是假反轉？美日匯市角力透露下一波行情關鍵
items.title_en: Is the 500-Point Surge in the Yen a False Reversal? The Struggle in the US-Japan Forex Market Reveals the Key to the Next Trend
paras: 就在日本央行週五 (31 日) 公布利率決議前夕，日元匯率出現劇烈反彈。市場消息顯示，日本當局可能在週四紐約交易時段再次出手干預外匯市場，而這次行動疑似獲得美國方面支持。
週四紐約交易時段，日元 / 美元 (JPYUSD) 一度急升逾 500 點，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來最大盤中漲幅。根據日本當地知情人士透露，此次干預目的在於提振日元匯率；與此同時，美國當局於東京時間凌晨 2 點 30 分左右進行「匯率詢價」（rate checks），此舉通常被市場視為美方可能準備介入匯市的前兆訊號。
市場人士認為，美方的相關行動提升了此次日本干預的市場影響力，也可能促使交易員在操作日元時更加謹慎。
美國財政部長斯貝森特週四受訪時表示，他認為日元「似乎被嚴重低估」，並指出匯率「過度波動」並不健康。
日本最高外匯官員三村淳週五被問及是否實施匯市干預時，並未正面回應，但表示日本從美國獲得的不僅僅是道義上的支持。
利率決議前夕精準狙擊
分析人士指出，日本此次選擇在日本央行貨幣政策會議前出手，可能是為了提高干預效果，並藉由突襲方式降低市場預期。
SMBC 日興證券高級外匯與利率策略師丸山凜斗（Rinto Maruyama）表示，在日本央行會議前進行干預，與今年 4 月較透明、容易被市場察覺的干預方式形成明顯差異。
他指出，近期日美兩國長期債券殖利率急升，是日本外匯干預以及美國匯率詢價行動背後的重要因素。另有分析認為，聯準會決議後美元指數意外走弱，也為日本當局進場干預創造較有利環境。
日元雖急升 貶值壓力仍未解除
在此次行情中，美元兌日元匯率一度跌至 157.98，亞洲時段最新交投約 160.67 附近。不過，儘管日元短線大幅反彈，過去 12 個月來日元兌美元仍累計貶值約 6%，在 G10 貨幣中表現墊底。
日本財務大臣片山皋月面對媒體詢問時表示，目前無法透露是否進行匯市干預，但重申當局持續保持高度警戒，隨時準備採取應對措施。
近幾個月來，日元持續承受貶值壓力，主要受到油價上漲、財政赤字，以及日美利率差擴大的影響。儘管日本當局上一季已在公開市場投入創紀錄的 11.73 兆日元（約 734 億美元）買入日元，但匯率仍持續走弱。
動用巨額資金救日元 挑戰全球匯市力量
根據日本財務省外匯儲備資料，日本先前可能動用了持有的外國證券，包括美國國債，作為干預匯市的資金來源。
這筆史無前例的資金規模，不僅凸顯日本面臨的匯率壓力，也反映出在全球每日交易規模達 9.5 兆美元的外匯市場中，單一國家想逆轉市場趨勢的難度。
利差問題未解 日元長線仍面臨考驗
日本自 2022 年重新重返外匯市場支撐日元後，並於 2024 年再次出手，試圖減緩日元兌美元貶值速度。日元長期走弱，主要源於全球央行在疫情後通膨升溫期間陸續升息，但日本央行長期維持負利率政策，以刺激經濟成長。
此次日元異動正值日本央行政策決議前夕，市場原先預期日本央行在上月升息後，將暫時維持利率不變。上月升息後，日本基準利率已升至 1995 年以來最高水準，投資人此前擔憂日本央行在應對通膨方面反應落後。
此外，儘管聯準會本週維持利率不變，市場仍預期今年稍晚可能降息，日美利率差距短期內仍可能維持對日元不利的格局。
對於此次干預效果，三井住友信託銀行紐約交易員山本武尊（Takeru Yamamoto）表示，當局此時出手可能讓外匯投資人重新評估風險，暫時降低拋售日元的意願。
paras_en: Just before the Bank of Japan's interest rate decision on Friday, the yen exchange rate experienced a sharp rebound. Market news showed that Japanese authorities may have intervened in the foreign exchange market again during the New York trading session on Thursday, and this action was suspected to have been supported by the US side.

During the New York trading session on Thursday, the yen/dollar (JPYUSD) once surged by more than 500 points, creating the largest intraday gain since December 2023. According to local informed sources in Japan, the purpose of this intervention was to boost the yen exchange rate; meanwhile, the US authorities conducted 'rate checks' around 2:30 am Tokyo time, which is usually seen by the market as a sign that the US may be preparing to intervene in the forex market.

Market participants believe that the US side's related actions have enhanced the market impact of Japan's intervention and may have prompted traders to be more cautious when operating the yen. US Treasury Secretary Spencent said in an interview on Thursday that he thought the yen was 'severely undervalued' and pointed out that excessive exchange rate fluctuations are unhealthy.

Japan's top foreign exchange official, Michinori Mochizuki, was asked on Friday whether forex intervention was implemented, but did not respond directly, saying that Japan had received more than just moral support from the US.

Analysts pointed out that Japan's choice to intervene before the Bank of Japan's monetary policy meeting may have been to increase the effectiveness of the intervention and reduce market expectations through a surprise attack.

Rinto Maruyama, senior forex and rates strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, said that intervening before the Bank of Japan meeting was significantly different from the more transparent intervention method in April, which was easier for the market to detect.

He pointed out that the recent surge in long-term bond yields in Japan and the US was an important factor behind Japan's forex intervention and the US's rate check action. Another analysis suggested that the unexpected weakness in the US dollar index after the Fed's decision also created a more favorable environment for Japan's intervention.

Although the yen surged, the downward pressure on the currency has not been alleviated. In this trend, the dollar/yen exchange rate once fell to 157.98 and was recently trading around 160.67 in the Asian session. However, despite the yen's short-term sharp rebound, it has accumulated a depreciation of about 6% against the US dollar over the past 12 months, ranking last among G10 currencies.

Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima said when facing media inquiries that he could not disclose whether forex intervention was conducted, but reiterated that the authorities remain highly vigilant and are ready to take countermeasures at any time.

In recent months, the yen has continued to face downward pressure, mainly due to rising oil prices, fiscal deficits, and the widening interest rate differential between Japan and the US. Although the Japanese authorities invested a record 1.173 trillion yen (approximately $7.34 billion) in the open market to buy yen last quarter, the exchange rate continued to weaken.

Using huge funds to save the yen challenges the global forex market's strength. According to the Japanese Ministry of Finance's foreign exchange reserve data, Japan may have used its holdings of foreign securities, including US Treasury bonds, as a funding source for intervening in the forex market.

This unprecedented scale of funds not only highlights the exchange rate pressure Japan faces but also reflects the difficulty for a single country to reverse market trends in the global forex market, where daily trading volume reaches $9.5 trillion.

The interest rate differential problem has not been resolved, and the yen still faces a long-term test. Japan has been back in the forex market to support the yen since 2022 and intervened again in 2024 to slow down the yen's depreciation against the US dollar. The yen's long-term weakness mainly stems from global central banks' rate hikes during the post-pandemic inflation period, while the Bank of Japan has maintained a negative interest rate policy to stimulate economic growth.

This yen fluctuation occurred just before the Bank of Japan's policy decision, and the market had initially expected the Bank of Japan to maintain interest rates unchanged after last month's rate hike. After the rate hike last month, Japan's benchmark interest rate has risen to its highest level since 1995, and investors had previously been concerned that the Bank of Japan was lagging behind in responding to inflation.

Additionally, although the Fed maintained interest rates this week, the market still expects a possible rate cut later this year, and the Japan-US interest rate differential may continue to be unfavorable to the yen in the short term.

Regarding the effect of this intervention, Takeru Yamamoto, a New York trader at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, said that the authorities' intervention at this time may have prompted forex investors to reevaluate risks and temporarily reduced their willingness to sell the yen.

paras: 韓元兌美元匯率今 (31) 日早盤一度升值至九個月高點，此前首爾外匯當局疑似實施了匯率維穩操作。
首爾時間上午 6 點左右，韓元兌美元升值至 1418 韓元，創 2025 年 10 月 20 日以來的最高水準。截至當地時間今日上午 9 時 37 分，韓元兌美元報 1430 韓元。
韓元的升值與日元的上漲同步。在週四 (30 日) 紐約交易時段，日元兌美元匯率一度升值 3.3%，創下自 2023 年 12 月以來的最大盤中升幅紀錄。對此市場普遍猜測日本當局出手干預。
首爾 KB 國民銀行分析師 Lee Min-hyuk 表示，韓元與日元之間的相關性引發了外界猜測，兩國外匯監管機構可能已介入市場。
他並推測說：「韓元和日元隔夜走強「恐顯示韓日當局可能已共同干預」。
市場正屏息等待日本央行 (BOJ) 決議，總裁植田和男的記者會將決定日元這輪反彈是趨勢反轉，還是短暫脈衝。BOJ 預計維持政策利率在 1% 不變，決議可能獲得政策委員會廣泛多數支持。BOJ 也將發布季度展望報告，包含更新的經濟成長和通膨率估值，而受到日本國內活動韌性和 AI 相關投資的強勁需求支撐，決策官員可能上調日本成長預期，
日元大漲後，日本政府不願證實是否在隔夜交易期間干預匯市，但暗示得到了美國官員等海外同行的支持。
日本財務大臣片山皋月今日迴避日元飆升是否是干預結果的問題，僅稱將「保持高度警惕，並採取適當措施」。
隨後不久，日本外匯事務負責人三村淳暗示，一直得到美國同行和其他國家的支持。
三村淳說，「確實意識到，我們從美國獲得的支持不僅僅是道德上的支持」，並稱已透過個人管道與美國當局保持密切聯繫，但拒絕透露更多細節。
paras_en: The South Korean won (KRW) appreciated to a nine-month high against the US dollar in early trading today, following suspected intervention by Seoul's foreign exchange authorities. The won rose to 1,418 KRW per USD around 6:00 am local time, its highest level since October 20, 2025, and was trading at 1,430 KRW per USD as of 9:37 am local time.

The won's gain was synchronized with the yen's (JPY) surge. In Thursday's New York trading session, the yen appreciated 3.3% against the USD, marking its largest intraday gain since December 2023, sparking speculation about potential intervention by Japanese authorities.

Lee Min-hyuk, an analyst at KB Kookmin Bank in Seoul, stated that the correlation between the won and the yen has led to speculation about possible intervention by the foreign exchange authorities of both countries. He further speculated that the overnight strength of the won and the yen might indicate joint intervention by South Korean and Japanese authorities.

The market is eagerly awaiting the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) decision, with Governor Kazuo Ueda's press conference set to determine whether the yen's rebound is a trend reversal or a short-term pulse. The BOJ is expected to maintain its policy rate at 1%, with the decision likely to receive broad support from the policy committee. The BOJ will also release its quarterly outlook report, including updated estimates for economic growth and inflation, which may be revised upward due to strong domestic demand and AI-related investments.

Following the yen's significant surge, the Japanese government declined to confirm whether it had intervened in the currency market during overnight trading but hinted at receiving support from US officials and other overseas counterparts. Japanese Finance Minister Tsukasa Makishima avoided commenting on whether the yen's surge was a result of intervention, stating only that the government would 'remain highly vigilant and take appropriate measures'.

Soon after, Japan's foreign exchange chief, Junichi Suzuki, suggested that the country had received support from the US and other nations. Suzuki stated, 'We are aware that the support we receive from the US is not just moral support', and mentioned that Japan had maintained close contact with US authorities through personal channels, but refused to disclose further details.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 日元突飆升 市場疑日本政府出手
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, Yen Soars, Market Suspects Japanese Government Intervention
paras: 美元周四 (30 日) 下跌，交易員對聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 強調抗通膨立場持懷疑態度。同時，日元大幅升值，創下 2022 年以來最大單日漲幅。分析認為，這波走勢看起來像是日本政府正式介入外匯市場。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 1%，報 99.89，寫下 4 月 21 日以來最差單日表現。
截至發稿，尚未確認日本當局是否進場交易，但日元如此大幅波動，加上銀行回報外匯交易量明顯高於平常，都顯示可能存在官方干預。
美元兌日元一度下跌 3%，至 158.34 日元，低於本周稍早創下的近 164 日元、40 年高點。
日本央行 (BoJ) 將於周五公布最新利率決策。周三美國聯準會維持利率不變，但美元受到打擊，因交易員開始質疑聯準會新任主席是否真的會積極遏制通膨。
三菱 UFJ 摩根士丹利證券外匯策略師 Daisaku Ueno 表示，「很難想像，除了外匯干預外，還有什麼因素能讓日元在如此短的時間內升值 5 日元。」
「如果這確實是一次干預，許多市場參與者原本預期干預會發生在 FOMC 與日本央行會議之後，因此當局可能有意讓市場措手不及。」
外匯交易量也同步大幅增加。花旗銷售與交易部門在給機構客戶的報告中指出，美東時間上午 9:30 至 9:40 期間，其電子交易平台估計在主要外匯交易市場有約 81 億美元的美元兌日元賣單。
花旗表示，「干預看起來是合理可能的解釋。」
日元兌歐元與英鎊同步升值逾 2%，兌澳幣則升值近 2%。
債市未完全信服華許立場
投資人持續消化聯準會周三決定維持利率不變的影響，目前市場焦點更多放在華許會後記者會上的談話。
雖然聯準會維持利率不變大致符合市場預期，但由於油價劇烈波動引發通膨環境快速變化，市場對升息的預期高於近期歷史水準。

華許也表示，三位地方聯準銀行總裁的反對票「並未完全反映整場討論的本質」，而 6 月通膨數據走弱對此次利率決策影響「並不大」。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Thursday (the 30th) as traders expressed skepticism toward Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's emphasis on an anti‑inflation stance. At the same time, the yen rallied sharply, posting its biggest one‑day gain since 2022. Analysts said the move looks like a formal intervention by the Japanese government in the foreign‑exchange market.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, dropped 1% to 99.89, marking its worst single‑day performance since April 21.

At the time of writing, it has not been confirmed whether Japanese authorities entered the market, but the yen’s extreme volatility, combined with bank‑reported FX trading volumes clearly above normal, suggests possible official intervention.
The dollar‑yen pair fell as much as 3% to ¥158.34, below the near‑¥164 level—a 40‑year high—set earlier this week.

The Bank of Japan will announce its latest rate decision on Friday. The Fed kept rates unchanged on Wednesday, but the dollar was hit as traders began to doubt whether the new Fed chair would aggressively curb inflation.
Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley FX strategist Daisaku Ueno said, "It's hard to imagine any factor other than FX intervention that could push the yen up by five yen in such a short time."
"If this is indeed an intervention, many market participants had expected it to occur after the FOMC and BoJ meetings, so the authorities may have deliberately caught the market off‑guard," he added.

FX trading volume also surged. Citi’s sales and trading division noted in a report to institutional clients that between 9:30 a.m. and 9:40 a.m. ET, its electronic platform estimated about $8.1 billion of dollar‑yen sell orders in the major FX market.
Citi said, "Intervention looks like a plausible explanation."
The yen also appreciated over 2% against the euro and the pound, and rose nearly 2% against the Australian dollar.
Bond market not fully convinced by Warsh’s stance
Investors continue to digest the impact of the Fed’s Wednesday decision to keep rates steady, with market focus now shifting to Warsh’s remarks at the post‑meeting press conference.

Although the Fed’s hold was broadly in line with expectations, the rapid swing in oil prices has sparked a quickly changing inflation environment, leaving rate‑hike expectations above recent historical levels.

Warsh said after the press conference that the Federal Open Market Committee had a "good family debate" with "vigorous and thorough discussion," focusing on four topics: persistent inflation, recent economic shocks and the price pressures they generate, and monetary‑policy tools.

He also noted that the three regional Fed bank presidents’ dissenting votes "did not fully reflect the nature of the discussion," and that the weaker June inflation data had "little impact" on the rate decision.

Macquarie FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman observed, "We gleaned several observations from the press conference. One is that Warsh is deliberately postponing a Fed policy‑rate hike, using rhetoric instead of action, while trying to mask or shift his fundamentally dovish stance."
After the Fed decision and Warsh’s remarks were released, U.S. Treasury yields diverged on Wednesday: long‑term yields rose, while shorter‑term, policy‑sensitive yields fell.
That trend continued on Thursday. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield rose more than 4 basis points to 4.666%, while the 2‑year yield slipped slightly to 4.234%.
